https://fortune.com/2026/11/14/vietnam-s.title_zh: 一座耗资3亿美元的物流枢纽押注越南能够超越组装线生产模式
https://fortune.com/2026/11/14/vietnam-s.body_zh: “今年美国关税已经改了三次，”Vietnam SuperPort首席执行官Yap告诉《财富》杂志。年初时，越南商品的关税税率为20%，这是华盛顿与河内根据2025年10月达成的临时贸易框架所确定的。随后在2月，美国最高法院裁定美国总统唐纳德·特朗普于2025年4月加征的对等关税违法；作为回应，特朗普对所有进口商品加征了全球统一的10%关税。自7月以来，在美国依据“301条款”调查强迫劳动执法情况后，大多数越南商品目前被征收12.5%的进口税。关税很可能再次变动——原因可能是美国与越南正在进行的贸易谈判，也可能是美国进一步调查工业产能过剩和知识产权保护。“如今，企业已经不再看重稳定性，”Yap说。“它们现在是在为不确定性做准备。”Yap是Vietnam SuperPort的首席执行官。该公司是新加坡家族物流企业YCH Group与越南企业集团T&T Group的合资企业。这座占地83公顷的物流枢纽位于河内北部的富寿省，处在连接越南电子制造带与中国边境的通道上，大多数零部件来自中国。其构想是将公路、铁路、航空和海运整合为一项服务，让出口商只需选择一条可预测的运输路线，而不必对接四种不同运输方式。SuperPort的空运货站已经投入运营。Yap声称，自7月以来，月收入增长了五倍。客户包括FedEx、全球主要货运代理企业以及顶尖电子产品和人工智能硬件公司。Yap说，他一直遵循的准则是成为“首选且最值得信赖的合作伙伴”。如今，这一本能正在全国范围内接受考验。SuperPort这座耗资约$300 million的枢纽，是越南能否从常规的最终组装环节升级为真正的物流和增值产业基地的一次押注。SuperPort空运货站处理消费电子产品、人工智能服务器机架和网络设备；这些货物价值高到值得采用空运，同时又敏感到需要TAPA安全认证。如今，这一战略面临两项挑战。一项来自华盛顿：在关税反复调整、美国针对越南的调查不断增加的情况下，标有“越南制造”的商品能否继续进入美国市场。（美国大约购买越南全部出口商品的三分之一。）另一项来自河内：该国能否建设足够的基础设施、能源供应和技能体系，以维持其高速增长。2026年第三季度，越南经济增长9.95%，使该国接近河内全年增长10%的目标。 尽管贸易持续面临不确定性，伊朗战争也造成 disruptions，该国的经济增长速度仍 somehow 超过去年的8% GDP增幅。Yap称之为“超级正常”的经济：在增长较慢的经济中可能只是小麻烦的问题，在越南这样增长更快的经济体中会成为真正的增长障碍。出口仍是越南增长的主要驱动力。今年前十个月，该国出口了价值近$500 billion的商品。其中很大一部分贸易来自美国这个越南最重要的出口伙伴；截至目前，该国今年对美贸易顺差为$140 billion。越南如今已经稳稳融入“中国加一”供应链，将生产活动，尤其是最终组装环节，放在成本较低且可能享有较低关税的第三国。中国制造的零部件如今跨境进入越南，由Samsung、Foxconn等企业旗下工厂组装；成品随后运往美国、欧洲以及亚洲各地市场。然而，这些跨境供应链的成本会不断累积。目前，物流成本约为越南GDP的16%至20%；河内希望到2030年将这一比例降至12%以下。Yap表示，这些成本来自行政手续、海关和运输费用，要么由出口商承担，要么转嫁给消费者。在Yap看来，“更智能的基础设施”是降低这些成本的唯一途径。中国和越南都在投入数十亿美元建设基础设施，以加深两国经济一体化。越南正投入$11 billion建设老街—河内—海防铁路。该线路采用现代化标准轨，设计上要把中国铁路网从北部边境直接连接到海防深水港，从而降低中国零部件和越南出口商品在中国边境与海运之间的运输成本和时间。该国还在以新建成的新山一国际机场取代胡志明市已超负荷运转的 Tan Son Nhat 机场，新机场应能将更多货运能力转移至越南南部。中国方面于9月开通了全长134公里的平陆运河，为该国西南工业地区开辟了首条直通水域的出海通道，并将航线指向南方越南，而非向东通往广州。此前，广西货物必须沿西江航行数百公里才能抵达珠江三角洲；如今，载重不超过5,000吨的船只可直接驶入北部湾，缩短行程560多公里。据北京估算，物流成本最多可降低30%。能源是越南的另一个瓶颈。尽管包括可再生能源在内的新增发电项目获得了大量投资，一些省份仍出现停电。与此相关的一项制约是资金：一些估算认为越南的资金缺口高达$200 billion；另一些估算则称，到2030年电力行业将需要$142 billion。“目前存在一个项目可融资性问题，”他说。越南在这些供应链中的地位引起华盛顿方面的关注，特朗普政府中的一些人士认为，这可能成为中国企业规避美国关税的途径。其理由是，中国商品若在越南只进行最低限度的增值活动，就能获得“越南制造”标签，从而避开中国制造商品所面临的更高关税。（在去年美国与越南达成的临时贸易协议中，河内同意对被认定从中国转运的商品征收40%的关税，但协议没有说明这具体意味着什么，也没说将如何调查。）Yap也在思考增值问题，不过他是站在越南的角度来考虑。“重要的是商品如何得到安全处理、产品质量如何，以及价值流向哪里，”他说。“价值是否留在境内？它是否流向越南管理者和企业成长的方向，还是流向境外？”越南正争取到2045年实现高收入国家地位。Yap认为，这一转变意味着从单纯的组装走向真正的创新，投入资源培养工程、自动化、半导体封装和物流方面的技能。河内希望到2030年，新技术产业贡献GDP的6%，主要由Viettel和FPT等本土企业推动。以多数标准来看，Yap的履历很不寻常。他曾在新加坡武装部队服役十余年，其中包括美国海军海豹突击队训练。30岁时完成首个学位，后来在东南亚新兴市场担任商业领导职位，并在新加坡担任KPMG和EY-Parthenon的咨询职位。其中一个市场是缅甸。Yap形容缅甸看上去与越南很相似，酒店里挤满了美国、韩国和泰国高管，他们都确信自己找到了下一个高增长市场。然而，2021年的军事政变推翻了这种信心，使缅甸原本的经济开放倒退了一代人的发展。如今，缅甸的经历影响着他看待越南的方式。“基础设施取决于投资者的信心，”他说。“我仍然对越南非常乐观。但我绝不会对越南掉以轻心。”SuperPort正在为这种不确定性做准备，而不是试图对抗它。Yap表示，客户现在会问他三个问题：“谁控制数据？谁核实原产地？有哪些路线可以重新调整，使货物从一个仓储地点转移至另一个仓储地点？”他的答案是一张网络：SuperPort计划到2030年在东南亚建设四个港口。柬埔寨SuperPort是位于金边附近磅湛省的一座占地130公顷的多式联运综合体，计划通过位于柬埔寨边境的西宁省一个规划中的枢纽与越南连接。关税今年可能第四次，甚至第五次变动：越南或许会被加征新的“301条款”关税，也可能是华盛顿与河内签署新的贸易协议，再次下调总体关税水平。在这一切之中，Yap始终关注关税无法改变的一件事：当地正在发生什么。“目前，我认为越南正处在上升轨道上，”他说。在《财富》杂志的“Asia Agenda”专栏中，我们每月至少两次与亚洲顶尖商业领袖对话，了解他们如何为未来布局，以及从全球增长最快、活力最强的地区之一的领先企业身上汲取的经验。可在此浏览我们的所有人物专访。图标 Nicholas Gordon是常驻香港的亚洲编辑，负责推动《财富》杂志对亚洲商业和经济新闻的报道。

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title: Delhi court denies bail to 2 men in 2023 parliament security breach case 101794642496590
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary: A Delhi court has denied bail to two men who allegedly jumped into the Lok Sabha chamber and released coloured smoke canisters during Parliament proceedings in December 2023, observing that their actions had “spread terror” among lawmakers and visitors and threatened the country’s “sovereignty and integrity”.
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 德里法院拒绝了两名男子保释。据称，两人于2023年12月闯入人民院会议厅并释放彩色烟雾罐。法院指出，他们的行为在议员和访客中“制造了恐慌”，并威胁到国家的“主权与完整”。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: A Delhi court has denied bail to two men who allegedly jumped into the Lok Sabha chamber and released coloured smoke canisters during Parliament proceedings in December 2023, observing that their actions had “spread terror” among lawmakers and visitors and threatened the country’s “sovereignty and integrity”. “The allegations against the accused persons are grave and serious, as their acts had resulted into disrupting the Parliamentary proceedings and had threatened the sovereignty and integrity of India,” the court observed. According to the prosecution, on December 13, 2023, at around 1 pm, when the proceedings of the Lok Sabha were being telecast live, Sharma and Manoranjan jumped from public gallery number four into the main chamber. Sharma allegedly moved towards the Well of the House by jumping over vacant seats before taking out a smoke canister concealed in his shoe and releasing its contents. Manoranjan also allegedly opened a coloured smoke canister inside the chamber. Yellow smoke engulfed parts of the House, prompting MPs and Parliament staff to intervene and apprehend the two men. The disruption forced an immediate adjournment of the Lok Sabha proceedings. Simultaneously, outside Parliament, the other two men named in the case, Ranoliya and Amol Shinde, allegedly released similar coloured smoke canisters and raised slogans while throwing pamphlets. They were subsequently apprehended. Two other men named in the case, Lalit Jha and Mahesh Kumawat, were subsequently arrested, and a First Information Report (FIR) was lodged by the Special Cell under multiple sections of the UAPA, the provision relating to criminal conspiracy and other related offences. The court, in its order, noted that the incident had caused widespread panic inside the House, with the actions of the two men inflicting terror on those present in the Lok Sabha. “The acts of the accused persons had inflicted terror in the minds of members and the visitors in the Lok Sabha,” it said, adding that images and scenes from Parliament had been broadcast across news channels immediately after the incident. The court also rejected the men’s argument that they should be granted bail on grounds of parity with the other two people named in the case, Neelam Ranoliya and Mahesh Kumawat, who were granted relief by the Delhi high court in July 2025. It pointed out that the roles attributed to the two men were substantially different from those of the other two. “However, the present two accused persons had entered the main Parliament and had jumped from the public gallery inside the Lok Sabha main Hall. The smoke canisters were concealed in the shoes and the Parliament proceedings were disrupted due to the act of the two accused persons,” the court said. Explaining the distinction in their roles, the court noted that Ranoliya had remained outside Parliament and refused to enter the building, while Kumawat was not even in Delhi on the day of the incident and had not attended the group’s last two meetings. The court also declined to accept the defence argument that prolonged incarceration and the likely delay in the trial warranted their release. It said that bail under Section 43D(5) of the UAPA could not be granted merely because of delays in proceedings and that the case was already pending a decision on framing of charges. The two men have been in custody since December 14, 2023. Their lawyers argued that the investigation was complete, with the main chargesheet and four supplementary chargesheets already filed, and that their continued incarceration would amount to an indefinite deprivation of personal liberty. They also contended that the alleged conduct did not constitute a terrorist act, that no toxic substance had been used and that there was no material to suggest an intention to cause damage to life or property. Rejecting these submissions, the court held that the material collected during the investigation, including witness statements and documentary evidence, satisfied the statutory threshold for denying bail under the anti-terror law. The investigation, as detailed in the prosecution’s reply to the bail applications, alleged that the incident was the culmination of a conspiracy that had been planned over several months, with Manoranjan and Sharma playing central roles. Investigators claimed that Manoranjan had begun exploring the possibility of targeting Parliament as early as 2022. A witness, Vaidyanath, allegedly told investigators that Manoranjan had contacted him that year to enquire about Parliament’s security arrangements. The prosecution further alleged that Manoranjan and Sharma used social media platforms to recruit associates and organised meetings in Mysuru and Gurugram, where they discussed plans to disrupt Parliament to attract national and international media attention. During one such meeting in February 2022, Manoranjan allegedly proposed creating chaos in Parliament to draw attention and generate funds, according to the prosecution. He also reportedly showed the group a video of a 2018 incident in Kosovo’s Parliament, where tear gas was used to disrupt proceedings, and drew a rough sketch of the Indian Parliament, the police told the court. The prosecution claimed that the group subsequently decided to use smoke canisters concealed inside specially modified sports shoes to gain entry into the Parliament building. Sharma allegedly procured smoke canisters in July 2023, while the group purchased shoes in August that year and carved cavities into their soles to conceal the canisters. Investigators also alleged that Manoranjan visited Parliament on July 25, 2023, to assess security arrangements and carry out reconnaissance. The group allegedly decided to execute the plan on December 13, coinciding with the anniversary of the 2001 Parliament attack, when the House was expected to observe a moment of silence in memory of those killed, police said. The court took note of the prosecution’s claim that the men were aware of a threat issued by designated terrorist Gurpatwant Singh Pannu regarding an attack on Parliament on December 13, 2023, and deliberately chose the same date to execute their plan. The judge also highlighted allegations that the men had taken steps to destroy evidence before the incident, including erasing data from their mobile phones, destroying SIM cards and handing over their devices to Lalit Jha, who was allegedly tasked with burning them and recording and circulating videos of the incident. “The fact that all the accused persons have erased all the data before the incident and had handed over their mobile phones alongwith SIM Cards to accused Lalit Jha who was assigned the task of destroying the mobile phones also, cannot be ignored,” the court observed. The court also noted that witness statements indicated that meetings had been organised to discuss the alleged plan and that the men had intended to create a situation of terror and disrupt Parliament on the anniversary of the 2001 attack
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 德里法院拒绝向2023年议会安全遭突破案中的两名男子提供保释 101794642496590
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 德里法院拒绝了两名男子的保释申请。据称，两人于2023年12月闯入人民院会议厅并释放彩色烟雾罐。法院指出，他们的行为在议员和访客中“制造了恐惧”，并威胁了国家的“主权和完整”。法院表示：“针对被告的指控严重且性质恶劣，因为他们的行为扰乱了议会 proceedings，并威胁了印度的主权和完整。”据控方称，2023年12月13日下午1点左右，人民院会议正在现场直播时，Sharma和Manoranjan从四号公众席跳入主会议厅。据称，Sharma从空席上跳起，越过座位走向议长席，随后从鞋中取出藏匿的烟雾罐并释放烟雾。Manoranjan据称也在会议厅内打开了彩色烟雾罐。黄色烟雾笼罩了会议厅的部分区域，促使议员和议会工作人员上前制止并拘捕这两名男子。此次扰乱导致人民院会议立即休会。与此同时，在议会外，案件中另外两名被指控人Ranoliya和Amol Shinde据称也释放了类似的彩色烟雾罐，并在散发传单时高喊口号。他们随后被拘捕。案件中另外两名被指名人Lalit Jha和Mahesh Kumawat随后被捕，特别行动小组依据《非法活动法》多项条款、有关刑事共谋的规定及其他相关罪行提交了首次信息报告。法院在命令中指出，该事件在会议厅内引发了广泛恐慌，两名男子的行为给人民院内的人员带来恐惧。法院称：“被告的行为在人民院议员和访客心中制造了恐惧。”法院还补充说，事件发生后，议会画面和现场景象立即通过各新闻频道播出。法院还驳斥了这两名男子关于应比照案件中另外两人获得保释的主张。Neelam Ranoliya和Mahesh Kumawat曾于2025年7月获德里高等法院救济。法院指出，这两名男子所涉角色与另外两人的角色有实质性区别。法院说：“然而，目前这两名被告进入了议会主建筑，并从公众席跳入人民院主厅。烟雾罐藏匿在鞋中，议会会议因这两名被告的行为而遭到扰乱。”法院在解释这些角色差异时指出，Ranoliya一直留在议会外并拒绝进入大楼，而Kumawat在事发当天甚至不在德里，也没有参加该团伙的最后两次集会。法院也不接受辩方关于长期羁押和审判可能延迟足以支持释放的主张。法院表示，不能仅因诉讼程序延迟而依据《非法活动法》第43D(5)条准予保释，且本案目前仍在等待是否起诉的裁定。这两名男子自2023年12月14日起一直被羁押。他们的律师辩称，调查已经完成，主要起诉书和四份补充起诉书均已提交，继续羁押他们等于无限期剥夺人身自由。他们还主张，所指行为不构成恐怖主义行为，没有使用有毒物质，也没有实质材料表明其意图对生命或财产造成损害。法院驳回了这些主张，认为调查期间收集的材料，包括证人陈述和文件证据，已达到依据反恐怖主义法律拒绝保释的法定门槛。控方在回复保释申请时详细说明了调查情况，指称该事件是历时数月策划的阴谋所导致的最终行动，Manoranjan和Sharma在阴谋中发挥了核心作用。调查人员称，Manoranjan早在2022年就开始探索以议会为目标的可能性。一名证人Vaidyanath据称告诉调查人员，Manoranjan曾在当年联系他，询问议会的安全安排。控方进一步指称，Manoranjan和Sharma利用社交媒体平台招募同伙，并在迈索尔和古尔冈组织集会，讨论扰乱议会以吸引国内外媒体关注的计划。据控方称，在2022年2月的一次此类集会上，Manoranjan提议在议会制造混乱，以吸引关注并筹集资金。他还给该团伙播放了一段2018年科索沃议会使用催泪瓦斯扰乱会议的录像，并向警方画出了印度议会的粗略草图。控方称，该团伙随后决定使用藏在经过特别改装的运动鞋内的烟雾罐，以进入议会大楼。据称，Sharma于2023年7月取得烟雾罐，该团伙则在同年8月购买鞋子，并在鞋底凿出空腔以藏匿烟雾罐。调查人员还指称，Manoranjan于2023年7月25日前往议会评估安全安排并实施侦察。警方称，该团伙决定于12月13日实施计划，该日适逢2001年议会袭击周年纪念日，议会预计将为遇难者默哀一分钟。法院记录了控方的一项主张，即这些男子知道被指定恐怖分子Gurpatwant Singh Pannu曾就2023年12月13日袭击议会发出威胁，却故意选择同一天实施计划。法官还强调，相关指控称这些男子在事发前采取了销毁证据的行动，包括从手机中删除数据、销毁SIM卡，并把设备交给Lalit Jha。Lalit Jha据称受命焚毁这些设备，并录制和传播事件视频。法院指出：“所有被告在事件发生前删除了所有数据，并将手机和SIM卡交给被告Lalit Jha，而Lalit Jha的任务还包括销毁这些手机；这一事实不能不予以重视。”法院还指出，证人陈述表明，曾举行会议讨论所指控的计划，这些男子意图在2001年袭击周年纪念日制造恐怖气氛并扰乱议会

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: The midterm elections in the United States that delivered a setback for President Donald Trump and led to a victory of the Democrats in the US Congress would not change India’s relationship with the country, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar said on Saturday. Speaking with R Sukumar, Editor-in-Chief, Hindustan Times, at the 24th Hindustan Times Leadership Summit in New Delhi, Jaishankar said that there is consensus between India and the US on defence and security cooperation and other matters that are “not partisan" in the United States. “In some cases, we will be focusing on the administration, for example, trade negotiations because it is their jurisdiction. To some extent, it would matter. To some extent, we would be continuing what we are doing,” he said. In the recently held midterm elections, the Democrats seized both the House of Representatives and the Senate from the Republicans. In the House of Representatives, the Democrats won 256 seats, while the Republicans won 169 seats, Associated Press reported. Meanwhile, the Democrats won 55 seats in the US Senate, leaving Republicans with 44 seats. The turbulence the world is going through could last a few years, maybe till the end of the decade, he said, adding that India's compass for navigating these choppy waters is the "lens of national interest". He touched upon the conflicts in West Asia and Ukraine, and also spoke of the crises parts of Africa are facing. Jaishankar spoke of a readjustment of the world order that includes the rise of new powers. The rivalry between the United States and China, he said, was one of the factors behind the ongoing frictions, but not the only one

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar said the US-India trade deal is expected to be closed soon, with bulk of the issues sorted out and last remaining concerns more at the American end than that of New Delhi. Jaishankar, while speaking at Hindustan Times Leadership Summit 2026, said that the aim is to have a trade deal with is mutually beneficial and balanced. Track LIVE updates from Hindustan Times Leadership Summit here “It is certainly our hope and, I would say, in many ways, our expectation that we are in the final stretch. That is no secret. If Mr Piyush Goyal were sitting here, he would be able to give you a more detailed answer. But my understanding, since we consult very closely on this matter, is that we have sorted out the bulk of the issues. There are a few remaining issues to be addressed,” Jaishankar said. He added that, “In many cases, these concerns are not so much on our side, because the changes have been more on the American side than ours. So, the hope is that we should be able to conclude the deal soon.” Talking about what he described as impatience towards the final stage of any big event, Jaishankar said, “But look, in the final stages of any negotiation, everybody becomes impatient. People want to know what the specific issues are and how long it will take. Negotiators don't usually disclose such details during a negotiation." "Many years ago, I was involved in a nuclear negotiation, and we went through a very similar experience. People would ask: How long will it take? When will you conclude it? What is holding it up?” he said. The foreign minister also touched upon the conflicts in West Asia and Ukraine, and also spoke of the crises parts of Africa are facing. Jaishankar spoke of a readjustment of the world order that includes the rise of new powers. The rivalry between the United States and China, he said, was one of the factors behind the ongoing frictions, but not the only one. A strong and steady leadership is imperative in these times, he said
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 苏杰生谈印美贸易协议：“大部分问题已经解决，剩余关切更多在美国方面”
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 外交部长S·贾伊尚卡恩博士表示，美印贸易协议预计很快就会敲定，大部分问题已经解决，剩余的少数关切更多出在美国方面，而非新德里方面。贾伊尚卡恩在《印度斯坦时报》领导力峰会2026年会议上说，目标是达成一份互惠互利、平衡平衡的贸易协议。读者可在此追踪《印度斯坦时报》领导力峰会的最新消息。贾伊尚卡恩说：“我们当然希望，而且我认为在很多方面也预期，我们已进入最后阶段。这并不是什么秘密。如果皮尤什·戈亚尔先生坐在这里，他能给出更详细的答复。但据我了解，由于我们在此事上密切磋商，我们已经解决了大部分问题。仍有少数问题需要处理。”他补充说：“在许多情况下，这些关切并非主要出在我们这边，因为变化更多发生在美国方面，而非我们方面。因此，希望我们很快就能敲定协议。”谈及他所说的任何重大活动进入最后阶段时都会产生的急躁情绪，贾伊尚卡恩说：“你看，在任何谈判的最后阶段，所有人都会变得急躁。人们想知道具体有哪些问题，以及需要多长时间。谈判代表通常不会在谈判期间披露这类细节。”他说：“许多年前，我参与过一场核问题谈判，我们经历了非常相似的情况。人们会问：需要多久？你们什么时候敲定？是什么阻碍了进展？”这位外交部长还谈及西亚和乌克兰的冲突，并谈到非洲部分地区正面临的危机。贾伊尚卡恩谈到世界秩序正在重新调整，其中包括新兴力量的崛起。他说，美国与中国之间的竞争是持续摩擦背后的因素之一，但并非唯一因素。他说，在这样的时代，强有力而稳定的领导至关重要

AFP 통신 등 외신에 따르면 올리비아 웨일스 백악관 공보 담당은 이날 기자들에게 미중러 정상이 17∼19일 중국 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의를 계기로 19일 3자 회동을 한다고 밝혔다. 웨일스는 "트럼프 대통령은 다른 의제들과 더불어 전 세계 핵무기 감축 문제를 논의하겠다는 입장을 분명히 해왔다"며 "트럼프 대통령은 이러한 핵확산이 매우 위험하다고 보고 있다"고 설명했다. 미 정부 고위 당국자들에 따르면 트럼프 대통령은 이번 3자 회담에서 핵 감축과 함께 현재 진행 중인 대(對)이란 전쟁 문제를 의제로 올릴 예정이다. 다만, 우크라이나 전쟁은 논의하지 않을 전망이다. 익명을 요구한 미 고위 당국자는 "대통령은 시 주석, 푸틴 대통령과의 3자 회담에서 이란 문제를 논의할 의향이 있다"면서도 우크라이나 전쟁에 대해서는 미국이 러시아, 우크라이나와 함께 가동 중인 '완전히 별개의 협상 트랙'이 있다고 선을 그었다. 트럼프 대통령의 특사들은 최근 아랍에미리트(UAE) 아부다비에서 러시아, 우크라이나 측과 3자 비공개 협상을 벌였다. 미 고위 당국자는 "중국은 그 협상 트랙의 일원이 아니기 때문에 그 자리에서 우크라이나 문제를 논의하는 것은 적절하지 않다"고 말했다. 또한 한 미국 당국자는 트럼프 대통령이 다음 주 아시아 방문 기간 김정은 북한 국무위원장과 만나지 않을 예정이라고 말했다고 로이터 통신이 보도했다. 트럼프 대통령이 15∼17일 필리핀 마닐라에서 열리는 동남아시아국가연합(ASEAN) 정상회의나 17∼19일 중국 선전에서 열리는 APEC 정상회의에서 어떤 방식으로든 김 위원장과 만날 계획이 현재로서는 없다는 입장을 밝힌 것이다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/14 11:07 송고 2026년11월14일 11시07분 송고 지난 2019년 6월 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령(왼쪽)과 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 판문점 군사분계선 북측 지역에서 만나 인사한 뒤 남측 지역으로 향하고 있다. https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111402.title_zh: 美国19日宣布美中俄领导人会谈结果……“特朗普与金正恩没有会谈安排”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111402.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者金升旭报道称，白宫宫长办公室于13日（当地时间）宣布，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平以及俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将于19日在中国深圳举行史上首次美中俄三国领导人会晤。据法新社等外媒报道，白宫新闻秘书办公室负责新闻发布事务的奥利维亚·韦尔斯当天对记者表示，美中俄三国领导人将以17日至19日在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议为契机，于19日举行三方会晤。韦尔斯说：“特朗普总统已明确表示，除其他议程外，还将讨论全球核武器削减问题”，并称“特朗普总统认为，这种核扩散极其危险”。据美国政府高级官员透露，特朗普总统计划在此次三方会谈中，除核军备削减外，还将把目前进行中的对伊朗战争问题列为议题。不过，预计不会讨论乌克兰战争。一名要求匿名的美国高级官员表示：“总统有意在与习近平主席、普京总统的三方会谈中讨论伊朗问题”，同时强调，对于乌克兰战争，美国与俄罗斯、乌克兰正在开展的是“一条完全不同的谈判轨道”。特朗普总统的特使近期在阿拉伯联合酋长国（UAE）阿布扎比与俄罗斯和乌克兰方面举行了三方闭门谈判。一名美国高级官员说：“由于中国不是该谈判轨道的成员，因此在那个场合讨论乌克兰问题并不合适”。此外，据路透社报道，一名美国官员表示，特朗普总统预计在下周访问亚洲期间不会会见朝鲜国务委员会委员金正恩。特朗普总统明确表示，目前无论如何都没有计划在15日至17日在菲律宾马尼拉举行的东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）领导人会议，以及17日至19日在中国深圳举行的APEC领导人会议上，以任何方式与金正恩委员长会面。投稿邮箱：KakaoTalk okjebo。版权所有© 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、发行及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月14日11时07分发布。2019年6月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（左）与朝鲜国务委员会委员金正恩在板门店军事分界线北侧地区会面并致意后，前往南侧地区。[摄影：裴载民]

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.summary_zh: 尼日利亚出口促进委员会（NEPC）执行董事兼首席执行官Nonye Ayeni女士在河套州霍尔港举行的国家单一窗口第二阶段出口宣传暨利益相关方论坛上说，该举措对于维持尼日利亚不断增长的非石油出口表现至关重要。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.body: Speaking at the National Single Window Phase 2 Export Sensitisation and Joint Stakeholders’ Forum in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Executive Director/Chief Executive Officer of the Nigerian Export Promotion Council (NEPC), Mrs. Nonye Ayeni, said the initiative was critical to sustaining the country’s growing non-oil export performance. Represented by Mr. Ndubueze Okeke, Director, Trade Information, the NEPC chief executive disclosed that Nigeria generated $6.1 billion in non-oil export earnings in 2025, representing an 11.5 per cent increase from the $5.46 billion recorded in 2024. While describing the performance as encouraging, the NEPC boss stressed that increased production alone would not guarantee Nigeria’s emergence as a leading non-oil exporting nation without efficient trade facilitation systems. “Nigeria’s ambition to become a leading non-oil exporting nation cannot be achieved by production alone. It also requires efficient systems that enable our businesses to move their products from local markets to international destinations with minimal delays, reduced costs and predictable regulatory processes,” the executive director said. She explained that the National Single Window, a federal government initiative, would provide a unified digital platform for submitting and processing trade-related documents, permits and approvals, thereby improving inter-agency coordination, eliminating duplication and reducing administrative burdens on businesses. The NEPC boss disclosed that the council had commenced its engagement and onboarding process to integrate relevant export-related services into the platform, including its Exporter’s Certificate registration service. She emphasised the need for exporters to understand the relationship between the NSW platform, the Trade Monitoring System (TRMS), Forms NXP and NCX, as well as applicable registration, permit and certification requirements. “Our objective is to ensure a seamless transition that simplifies processes rather than creates additional burdens for businesses,” she stated. The executive director said the Phase 2 implementation was particularly significant to the South-South region, given its vast opportunities in agriculture, fisheries, aquaculture, agro-processing and manufacturing. She urged exporters and business operators to participate actively in the technical sessions covering exporter’s certificate registration, NSW trader registration, TRMS and the processing of Forms NXP and NCX. According to her, the success of the initiative would depend not only on technology but also on effective collaboration among government agencies and the willingness of private-sector operators to embrace the new processes. Meanwhile, the Director of the National Single Window, Mr. Tola Fakolade, said the first component of Phase 2 would go live on December 14, beginning with the digital issuance of export permits by regulatory agencies, including the Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON), the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC), and the Federal Produce Inspection Service. He added that the second component, covering Central Bank of Nigeria processes, would be deployed in the first quarter of 2027. Fakolade said the platform would strengthen regulatory compliance and curb revenue leakages, noting that the first phase had simplified import documentation by allowing traders to submit licences and permits through a single platform. “Because of the enforced compliance on the platform, it actually forces users to be compliant. And when there is compliance, then there is blockage of revenue leakages,” he said. Also speaking, Comptroller Aondona Fanyam, in charge of Compliance and Modernisation at the Nigeria Customs Service Headquarters, said the initiative would eliminate repeated submission of documents to multiple government agencies. He explained that traders would submit their documents once, while relevant agencies would access the required information electronically through the platform. Fanyam identified capacity gaps, change management and differences in the digital capabilities of regulatory agencies as some of the challenges encountered during Phase 1, adding that stakeholder sensitisation and practical training were being intensified ahead of the next phase. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府采取行动消除出口瓶颈
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.body_zh: 在河流州哈科特港举行的国家单一窗口第二阶段出口宣传暨利益相关方联合论坛上，尼日利亚出口促进委员会（NEPC）执行董事兼首席执行官诺妮耶·阿耶尼表示，这一举措对于保持尼日利亚不断增长的非石油出口表现至关重要。NEPC首席执行官在贸易信息总监Ndubueze Okeke先生代表出席的情况下透露，尼日利亚2025年获得61亿美元非石油出口收入，较2024年的54.6亿美元增长11.5%。NEPC负责人在形容这一表现令人鼓舞的同时强调，如果没有高效的贸易便利化体系，仅靠增加产量无法确保尼日利亚成为领先的非石油出口国。“尼日利亚成为领先非石油出口国的目标不能仅靠生产来实现。它还需要高效的体系，使我们的企业能够将产品从本地市场运往国际市场，同时将延误降至最低、成本降下来，并确保监管流程可预测，”这位执行董事说。她 explained that 国家单一窗口是联邦政府的一项举措，将提供一个统一的数字平台，用于提交和处理贸易相关文件、许可证和审批，从而改善机构间协调，消除重复工作，并减轻企业的行政负担。NEPC负责人透露，该委员会已启动与相关方的接洽及平台接入流程，将出口相关服务整合到该平台，其中包括出口商证书注册服务。她强调，出口商需要了解NSW平台、贸易监测系统（TRMS）、NXP表格和NCX表格之间的关系，以及适用的注册、许可和认证要求。“我们的目标是确保实现平稳过渡，简化流程，而不是给企业增加额外负担，”她表示。执行董事表示，鉴于该地区在农业、渔业、水产养殖、农产品加工和制造业方面拥有巨大机遇，第二阶段的实施对南部地区尤其意义重大。她敦促出口商和经营者积极参加有关出口商证书注册、NSW贸易商注册、TRMS以及NXP表格和NCX表格处理的技术会议。她说，该举措能否成功不仅取决于技术，也取决于政府机构之间的有效协作，以及私营部门经营者接受新流程的意愿。与此同时，国家单一窗口主任Tola Fakolade先生表示，第二阶段的第一部分将于12月14日上线，首先由各监管机构以数字方式签发出口许可证，包括尼日利亚标准组织（SON）、国家食品药品监督管理总局（NAFDAC）和联邦农产品检验局。他补充说，涵盖尼日利亚中央银行相关流程的第二部分将于2027年第一季度部署。Fakolade表示，该平台将加强监管合规并减少收入流失，并指出第一阶段已通过允许贸易商通过一个平台提交许可证和批准文件，简化了进口文件要求。“由于平台实行强制合规，它实际上会迫使用户遵守规定。而一旦实现合规，就能堵住收入流失的漏洞，”他说。尼日利亚海关总署合规与现代化负责人Aondona Fanyam总审计长也表示，该举措将消除向多个政府机构反复提交文件的问题。他解释说，贸易商只需提交一次文件，相关机构便可通过平台以电子方式获取所需信息。Fanyam指出，各监管机构在能力建设、变革管理以及数字化能力方面的差异，是第一阶段实施过程中遇到的部分挑战；下一阶段启动前，各方正加强利益相关方宣传和实务培训。THISDAY创刊于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办公室。对于政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级而言，THISDAY是尼日利亚最具权威性的全平台新闻媒体，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报秉持公众信任，专注于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育、社区以及人与社会的交汇点等各类议题。您可以发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

Unlock these with Subscription The fifth round of the India-Bangladesh consular dialogue will be held on a “mutually convenient date”, the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said on Friday (November 13). Speaking to the media during the bi-weekly media briefing, Randhir Jaiswal, Official Spokesperson of the MEA, reiterated that India seeks to build “positive, constructive and forward-looking” relations with Bangladesh. “The next round of the India-Bangladesh Consular Dialogue, which will also take up matters relating to the Revised Travel Arrangement, will be held on a mutually convenient date. India remains ready to discuss all bilateral issues with Bangladesh through these existing mechanisms, including at the technical level,” Mr. Jaiswal said. The Hindu had reported on Thursday (November 12) about the postponement of the consular talks that were to be held on November 17 and 18. “India desires a positive, constructive, and forward-looking relationship with Bangladesh. Accordingly, initiatives have been taken and meetings held under our structured mechanisms in such areas as trade, railways, water resources, and border management, among others,” said Mr. Jaiswal. Diplomatic sources had indicated that the postponement was because of the spike in tensions in view of the proposed return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh. Ms. Hasina has been in India since August 5, 2024 and she has said that she would return to Dhaka in December. The two sides started consular dialogue in 2017 to strengthen people-to-people contact by having a regular channel of communication on consular, visa, and mutual legal assistance cooperation matters. Four rounds of consular dialogue were held during the rule of the Awami League in Dhaka. The MEA said the fourth round in May 2024 discussed issues such as “visa matters, repatriation, mutual legal assistance treaty cases, etc.” Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/c.title: China’s ICE Vehicle Push to Africa: What It Means for Nigeria
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/c.summary: China’s continued shipment of large numbers of internal combustion-engine (ICE) vehicles to Nigeria and other African markets is being driven less by a retreat from electric mobility than by a major restructuring of the Chinese automobile industry, with manufacturers increasingly looking overseas for markets, revenue and capacity utilisation.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/c.summary_zh: 中国继续向尼日利亚及其他非洲市场大量运输内燃机（ICE）汽车，其主要驱动力并非从电动出行领域退却，而是中国汽车行业正在进行重大重组；制造商越来越积极地到海外寻找市场、收入和产能利用空间。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/c.body: China’s continued shipment of large numbers of internal combustion-engine (ICE) vehicles to Nigeria and other African markets is being driven less by a retreat from electric mobility than by a major restructuring of the Chinese automobile industry, with manufacturers increasingly looking overseas for markets, revenue and capacity utilisation. The development has important implications for Nigeria, where weak charging infrastructure, unreliable electricity supply, high vehicle acquisition costs and limited consumer purchasing power continue to constrain the mass adoption of electric vehicles (EVs). China has become the world’s dominant vehicle manufacturing base while simultaneously undergoing one of the fastest transitions from petrol and diesel vehicles to new-energy vehicles. The result is a growing pool of conventional vehicles that manufacturers can still sell profitably in markets where the transition to electric mobility is slower. The International Energy Agency (IEA) said Chinese vehicle exports increased sharply in the first half of 2026 as domestic sales weakened, with total Chinese car exports rising 65 per cent year-on-year. Although electric-car exports grew even faster, ICE vehicles remain a major component of China’s overseas shipments. For Africa, the continent’s relatively young motorisation market makes it particularly attractive, according to IEA. Unlike Europe and some Asian markets, where stringent emissions regulations and EV incentives are accelerating the replacement of petrol and diesel vehicles, many African countries still depend heavily on conventional vehicles, particularly imported used cars. Nigeria is a major example. The country’s vehicle market remains overwhelmingly dependent on petrol and diesel technology, while the infrastructure required for large-scale EV adoption is still developing. China’s strategy therefore allows its automakers to serve different markets according to their level of technological transition. EVs can be targeted at markets with adequate charging networks and supportive policies, while ICE vehicles can continue flowing into markets where consumers prioritise affordability, driving range, easy access to mechanics and the availability of fuel. There is also a broader industrial dimension. China’s highly competitive automobile industry has experienced intense price competition and excess production capacity. Overseas markets provide manufacturers with an outlet for vehicles that may face declining demand at home. The IEA noted that Chinese automakers are increasingly relying on overseas markets as domestic growth slows, with major manufacturers setting ambitious export targets. For Nigeria, the influx presents both opportunities and risks. On the positive side, increased Chinese competition could make vehicles more affordable, expand consumer choice and force established global brands to reduce prices. It could also create opportunities for local assembly, component manufacturing, servicing and technical employment if Nigeria successfully links vehicle imports to an industrialisation strategy. But continued dependence on ICE imports could also slow Nigeria’s own transition to cleaner transportation. Nigeria’s Energy Transition Plan envisages a gradual shift towards electric mobility, while the country’s automotive policy seeks greater local vehicle production and increased EV manufacturing. The Nigerian Automotive Industry Development Plan, for instance, targets 30 per cent of locally produced vehicles being electric by 2032. The danger, therefore, is that Nigeria could become a dumping ground for ageing or declining ICE technology just as major manufacturers are moving their technological investments towards batteries, software and electric drivetrains. There is also an environmental and economic cost. Continued dependence on petrol and diesel vehicles means higher exposure to fuel-price shocks, import dependence and transport-sector emissions. Yet the answer is not necessarily to shut the door on Chinese ICE vehicles immediately. Nigeria’s transition must reflect its infrastructure realities. The government would need to expand charging infrastructure, stabilise electricity supply, establish battery and vehicle standards, develop local technical capacity and create incentives for manufacturers to assemble EVs locally. Importantly, 2035 is not a blanket deadline for China to stop producing or exporting every ICE vehicle. China’s official New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan says that by 2035, electric vehicles are expected to become the mainstream of new vehicle sales, while public transportation is expected to be fully electrified. A 2025 Chinese transport-energy guideline similarly states that by 2035, pure electric vehicles should become the mainstream of new vehicle sales. China’s target is market dominance by new-energy vehicles, not an announced universal ban on ICE vehicles by 2035. Conventional vehicles can therefore continue to be manufactured, sold or exported, particularly to markets such as Africa where demand remains strong. For Nigeria, this creates a policy dilemma: Chinese ICE vehicles may provide immediate, relatively affordable mobility, but an uncontrolled influx could lock the country into yesterday’s automotive technology just as the world’s largest vehicle manufacturing power accelerates towards tomorrow’s. He explained: “Let me be clear, we are not anti-China. We are pro-Nigeria. “We welcome Chery, Jetour, GAC, Changan, Geely, BYD. Their arrival has forced prices down. A Nigerian can now buy a brand new SUV for N28m instead of N55m. That is good for the consumer. Competition is good. But what we are seeing today is not competition. It is dumping. These are not assembled in Nigeria. Over 95% are imported fully built. Meanwhile, our own assemblers – Innoson in Nnewi, PAN in Kaduna, Nord in Lagos, Stallion in Lagos – are operating at less than 20% capacity. China is moving to EVs at home and pushing its excess ICE production to Africa. Nigeria is becoming the dumping ground. He said, “That is not a level playing field. That is policy failure. If you want to sell more than 1,000 cars a year in Nigeria, you must assemble in Nigeria within 3 years. If you sell cars in Nigeria, you must guarantee parts for 10 years and train Nigerian technicians. Nigeria should not replace tokunbo dependence with Chinese dependence. He stated that, “The biggest enemy of our sector is not China. It is our own policy inconsistency. “The National Automotive Industry Development Plan (NAIDP) says 35% for fully built, 10% for SKD, 5% for CKD. In practice, waivers are given to a few importers to bring fully built cars at 20%. That single waiver kills 10 assemblers.” a) Zero Waivers for Fully Built Cars. Publish all waivers. No secret waivers. b) 10-Year Policy Lock. No investor will build a $50m assembly plant if policy can change in 6 months. Lock it. Local Parts Manufacturing. Nigeria imports $180m in parts from China, $61m from Japan. We must give Pioneer Status to local brake pad, filter, battery and tyre manufacturers. And we must enforce SON standards – 60% of parts in our markets are fake.” Founded on January 22, 1995, THISDAY is published by THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD., 35 Creek Road Apapa, Lagos, Nigeria with offices in 36 states of Nigeria , the Federal Capital Territory and around the world. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/c.title_zh: 中国向非洲推广纯电动汽车：对尼日利亚意味着什么
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/c.body_zh: 中国继续向尼日利亚及其他非洲市场大量运送内燃机（ICE）汽车，其驱动力并非中国放弃电动出行，而是中国汽车产业正在进行重大重组。制造商日益转向海外市场，以寻找销路、收入并提高产能利用率。这一趋势对尼日利亚具有重要影响，因为充电基础设施薄弱、电力供应不稳定、购车成本高昂以及消费者购买力有限，仍在制约电动汽车（EV）的普及。中国已成为全球主导的汽车制造基地，同时也在经历从汽油和柴油汽车向新能源汽车过渡的最快阶段之一。这一结果意味着，传统汽车的数量不断增加；在向电动出行转型较慢的市场，制造商仍能以盈利方式销售这些汽车。国际能源署（IEA）表示，2026年上半年，随着国内销售走弱，中国汽车出口大幅增长，中国汽车出口总量同比增长65%。尽管电动汽车出口增长得更快，但ICE汽车仍是中国海外出口的重要组成部分。IEA称，非洲相对年轻的汽车化市场尤其具有吸引力。与欧洲和部分亚洲市场不同，那里严格的排放法规和EV激励措施正在加速汽油和柴油汽车被替代，而许多非洲国家仍高度依赖传统汽车，尤其是进口二手车。尼日利亚就是一个典型例子。该国的汽车市场仍压倒性地依赖汽油和柴油技术，而大规模采用EV所需的基础设施仍在发展之中。因此，中国的战略使其汽车制造商能够根据不同市场的技术转型程度开展业务。EV可以瞄准充电网络完善且政策支持的市场，而ICE汽车则可以继续流入消费者重视价格可负担性、续航里程、便于维修以及燃油供应的市场。这背后还有更广泛的产业层面。中国竞争激烈的汽车行业经历了激烈的价格竞争，并面临产能过剩。海外市场为制造商提供了出口渠道，以消化那些在国内可能面临需求下降的汽车。IEA指出，随着国内增长放缓，中国汽车制造商越来越依赖海外市场，主要制造商还设定了雄心勃勃的出口目标。对尼日利亚而言，大量涌入既带来机遇，也带来风险。从积极一面看，中国企业加大竞争可能使汽车价格更加亲民，扩大消费者选择，并迫使成熟的全球品牌降价。如果尼日利亚成功将汽车进口与工业化战略相结合，竞争还可能为本地组装、零部件制造、维修服务和技术就业创造机会。但持续依赖进口ICE汽车，也可能拖慢尼日利亚自身向更清洁交通方式转型的进程。尼日利亚《能源转型计划》设想逐步转向电动出行，该国的汽车政策则寻求提高本地汽车产量并增加EV制造。例如，《尼日利亚汽车产业发展计划》提出，到2032年，本地生产汽车中30%应为电动汽车。因此，危险在于，正当主要制造商将技术投资转向电池、软件和电驱动系统之际，尼日利亚可能成为老旧或落后ICE技术的倾销地。这还会带来环境和经济代价。持续依赖汽油和柴油汽车意味着更容易受到燃油价格冲击，对进口依赖加深，并增加交通运输业排放。然而，解决办法未必是立即将中国ICE汽车拒之门外。尼日利亚的转型必须反映其基础设施现实。政府需要扩大充电基础设施、稳定电力供应、建立电池和汽车标准、发展本地技术能力，并为制造商在本地组装EV提供激励。重要的是，2035年并不意味着中国必须全面停止生产和出口所有ICE汽车。中国官方的《新能源汽车产业发展规划》提出，到2035年，电动汽车预计将成为新车销售的主流，公共交通预计将全面实现电动化。2025年中国交通能源指导文件同样指出，到2035年，纯电动汽车应成为新车销售的主流。中国的目标是让新能源汽车占据市场主导地位，而不是宣布到2035年对ICE汽车实施全面禁令。因此，传统汽车仍可继续生产、销售或出口，尤其是在非洲等需求依然强劲的市场。对尼日利亚而言，这造成了一项政策困境：中国ICE汽车可以立即提供相对廉价的出行方式，但若不加控制地大量涌入，就可能在全球最大汽车制造国加速迈向未来技术之际，把这个国家锁定在昨天的汽车技术上。他解释道：“我要明确说明，我们不反对中国，我们支持尼日利亚。“我们欢迎奇瑞、捷途、广汽、长安、吉利、比亚迪。他们的到来迫使价格下降。尼日利亚人现在可以花2800万奈拉买到一辆全新SUV，而不必花5500万奈拉。这对消费者有利。竞争是好事。但我们今天看到的不是竞争，而是倾销。这些车不是在尼日利亚组装的。超过95%都是以整车形式进口的。与此同时，我们自己的组装厂——位于恩韦的Innoson、位于卡杜纳的PAN、位于拉各斯的Nord和Stallion——产能利用率均不足20%。中国在国内转向EV，同时把过剩的ICE产能推向非洲。尼日利亚正在成为倾销地。他说：“这不是公平的竞争环境。这是政策失灵。如果你想在尼日利亚每年销售超过1000辆汽车，就必须在3年内于尼日利亚组装。如果你在尼日利亚销售汽车，就必须保证10年的零部件供应，并培训尼日利亚技术员。尼日利亚不应在摆脱对‘tokunbo’的依赖之后，又转而依赖中国。他表示：“我们这个行业最大的敌人不是中国，而是我们自身政策的不一致。“《国家汽车产业发展计划》（NAIDP）规定，整车进口税率为35%，SKD为10%，CKD为5%。但在实际操作中，少数进口商获得了20%的整车进口豁免。仅这一项豁免就足以让10家组装厂无以为继。a）对整车实行零豁免。公布所有豁免情况，不允许任何秘密豁免。b）锁定10年政策。如果政策6个月就能改变，没有投资者会建设一座价值5000万美元的组装厂。因此必须锁定政策。本地零部件制造。尼日利亚每年从中国进口1.8亿美元零部件，从日本进口6100万美元零部件。我们必须给予本地制动片、滤清器、电池和轮胎制造商‘先锋地位’。我们还必须执行SON标准——我们市场上60%的零部件都是假货。”THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-air-force.summary_zh: 美国空军表示，星期五晚间已对英国萨福克郡拉肯希思皇家空军基地上空“疑似未经授权的无人机活动”作出回应。英国国防部发言人对 BBC 表示，正在“与所有相关方协调”，并补充说，美国空军安全人员已对有关报告作出回应，局势已经解决。拉肯希思皇家空军基地驻扎着美国空军第48战斗机联队，又称“自由之翼”，其中有近7000名现役军人，部分人员驻扎在基地。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-air-force.body: The US Air Force said it responded to "suspected unauthorised drone activity" over RAF Lakenheath in Suffolk on Friday evening. No personnel, aircraft or infrastructure were affected, a spokesperson for the US Air Force said. It comes after unconfirmed reports that sirens were sounded at the base, which residents reported hearing from a nearby village. A Ministry of Defence spokesperson told the BBC it was "coordinating with all relevant parties", adding that US Air Force security personnel responded to the reports and the situation was resolved. "We are working closely with them to establish the facts," they added. West Suffolk MP Nick Timothy said he had been in touch with authorities at the base, and was told "there is no threat to the public, and the incident is now resolved". "Given the raised threat level, I continue to encourage everyone to report anything suspicious or out of the ordinary to the authorities," he added in a social media post. Earlier this week, at least 12 US Air Force aircraft departed the nearby RAF Mildenhall base. They included two Boeing Stratotanker KC-135 refuelling aircraft, with one apparently headed towards Germany and another seen landing at Prestwick Airport near Glasgow. There has been heightened security activity at US bases in the UK following an incident at RAF Fairford in September that Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Iran played a part in. Police said petrol but no explosives were found during searches of vans near the base. Two men have been charged by the Crown Prosecution Service over their alleged involvement in the incident. While Iran denied any responsibility, the US removed all of its bombers from the base in October. The Wall Street Journal reported the departure of the US aircraft from RAF Mildenhall this week was in response to a further threat from Iran but the BBC has not independently verified the claim. Earlier this week, Downing Street insisted British airbases were safe and that their security is a "top priority". RAF Lakenheath hosts the US Air Force's 48th Fighter Wing, or the Liberty Wing as it is also known, which has nearly 7,000 active-duty personnel, some of whom are stationed at the base. The Liberty Wing is the largest US fighter operation in Europe, its website says, employing four combat ready fighter squadrons

https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-air-force.body_zh: 美国空军表示，星期五晚间对英国萨福克郡RAF Lakenheath上空“疑似未经授权的无人机活动”作出回应。美国空军发言人说，没有人员、飞机或基础设施受到影响。此前有未经证实的报道称，该基地拉响了警报，附近村庄的居民称听到了警报声。英国国防部发言人对BBC表示，正在“与所有相关方协调”，并补充说，美国空军安全人员对有关报告作出回应，局势已经解决，对方还表示：“我们正与他们密切合作，以查明事实。”西萨福克郡议员Nick Timothy表示，他已与基地当局联系，并被告知“公众不存在威胁，事件目前已经解决”。他还在社交媒体帖子中补充说：“鉴于威胁等级已经提高，我继续鼓励所有人向当局报告任何可疑或异常情况。”本周早些时候，至少12架美国空军飞机从附近的RAF Mildenhall基地起飞，其中包括两架Boeing Stratotanker KC-135加油机，其中一架显然飞往德国，另一架则被发现在格拉斯哥附近的Prestwick机场降落。9月RAF Fairford发生事件后，英国境内的美国基地加大了安全行动力度，首相Andy Burnham称伊朗参与其中。警方表示，在基地附近搜查货车时发现了汽油，但没有发现爆炸物。皇家检察署已就两名男子涉嫌卷入该事件提出指控。尽管伊朗否认负有责任，美国仍在10月将所有轰炸机撤出该基地。《华尔街日报》报道称，本周美国飞机离开RAF Mildenhall是为了应对伊朗发出的进一步威胁，但BBC尚未独立核实这一说法。本周早些时候，唐宁街坚持称英国空军基地是安全的，保障其安全是“首要优先事项”。RAF Lakenheath驻扎着美国空军第48战斗机联队，也称“自由之翼”，拥有近7,000名现役人员，其中部分驻扎在该基地。该联队官网称，“自由之翼”是美国在欧洲规模最大的战斗机作战部队，配备4个战备fighter中队

https://leadership.ng/presidency-release.body: The Presidency has released video footage showing President Bola Tinubu leaving a mosque after observing Friday prayers, in a move to counter claims circulating among opposition supporters about his whereabouts. Senior Adviser to the President on Digital and New Media, Otega Ogra shared the footage on his X handle on Friday, describing reports and videos being circulated by opposition supporters as misleading. In the post, Ogra accused the opposition of pushing a false narrative about the President, alleging that videos circulating online featured individuals he described as paid thugs at the mosque. He maintained that the footage released by the Presidency showed Tinubu leaving the mosque after observing the Friday congregational prayers. He added, “Contrary to the narrative being pushed by the opposition, with videos of their alleged paid thugs at the Mosque today, here is footage of Mr. President leaving the mosque after Friday prayers this afternoon.” The presidential aide accompanied the post with a message of support for Tinubu and the country, saying, “God bless our President. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body: The First Lady of Nigeria, Senator Oluremi Tinubu, received a rousing welcome from thousands of residents and supporters during her visit to Zamfara State. On Tuesday, the Zamfara State Government hosted the APC North-West Women’s Mega Rally and Empowerment Programme at the Trade Fair Complex in Gusau. The event, led by Zamfara First Lady Huriyya Dauda Lawal, brought together former Zamfara governors, the first ladies of the North-West, ministers and other key All Progressives Congress stakeholders. Before the rally, Senator Tinubu met with the Zamfara State traditional rulers to seek their blessings. In her remarks, Mrs Tinubu described her visit as a powerful expression of solidarity and compassion, as well as a commitment to women’s welfare and advancement, especially for those facing insecurity, poverty and limited economic opportunities. She said, “This is the happiest day of my life. Except for Zamfara, I have been in all 36 states of Nigeria, including the FCT. I have always wanted to come to Zamfara, and today I have fulfilled that. Because it is now easy to come, this is just the beginning; I am coming back again. Mr President is also coming. “Before I start, I want to commiserate with you all for all the lives that were lost; they are very precious to us. May God forgive them, grant them Al-Jannatul Firdaus, and continue to be with us. “Today is Juma’at; we have to be fast; we have empowerment to give to women. This is the only party that empowers during the campaign, and it is not about the campaign; we have been empowering from day one. And that is why it is not politics. “Earlier, I was also given a title in Zamfara, the ‘Jagaban Matan Arewa’ by the Chairman of the Zamfara State Council of Chiefs and Emir of Anka, Alhaji Attahiru Muhammad Ahmad. I thanked all the Emirs. “I love Zamfara. I am happy to be here. Mr President said I should tell you he will continue working for you. Nigeria will continue to prosper, in sha Allah.” Earlier, Governor Dauda Lawal thanked Senator Tinubu for her continued support through the Renewed Hope Initiative, including its Food Outreach Programme. “Your Excellency, Mother of the Nation, your presence today represents more than an official visit. You have set a record in the history of our dear Zamfara State. “Your Excellency, Distinguished ladies and gentlemen, in Zamfara State, we firmly believe that empowering women is not only our responsibility as a government; it is a needed and bankable investment in social and societal morality, economic prosperity, family stability, and sustainable peace. “I assure Your Excellency that Zamfara’s government and people unwaveringly support Mr President’s second term. With the women here and the men supporting them, Zamfara and the North West will deliver for Mr President come January 2027.”
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.title_zh: 扎姆法拉迎宾第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布，举行大型集会；925054
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body_zh:
尼日利亚第一夫人、参议员奥卢雷米·蒂努布在她访问赞法拉州期间，受到数千名居民和支持者的热烈欢迎。周二，赞法拉州政府在古绍的贸易展览中心主办了全进步大会党西北部妇女大型集会暨赋权计划。活动由赞法拉州第一夫人胡里娅·达乌达·拉瓦勒主持，赞法拉州历任州长、西北部各州第一夫人、部长及全进步大会党其他重要人士齐聚一堂。集会前，蒂努布参议员会见赞法拉州传统 ruler，争取他们的祝福。蒂努布夫人在讲话中表示，此次访问有力体现了团结与关怀，也表明政府致力于改善妇女福祉、推动妇女发展，尤其关注那些面临安全局势恶化、贫困和经济机会有限的妇女。她说：“这是我一生中最快乐的一天。除了赞法拉州，我走遍了尼日利亚全部36个州，包括联邦首都区。我一直想来赞法拉州，今天终于实现了。因为现在来这里已经很容易了，所以这才是开始；我还会再来。总统先生也会来。

“开始之前，我想对所有失去生命的人表示深切哀悼；他们的生命对我们非常宝贵。愿真主宽恕他们，赐予他们天堂的福地，并继续庇佑我们。

“今天是主麻日；我们必须抓紧时间；我们还有赋权成果要交给妇女。这是唯一一个在竞选期间为妇女赋权的政党，而且这并不只是竞选活动；我们从第一天起就一直在推动赋权。也正因为如此，这并不只是政治。

“此前，我还被授予了赞法拉州‘Jagaban Matan Arewa’的头衔，授予者是赞法拉州酋长委员会主席兼安卡埃米尔阿塔希鲁·穆罕默德·艾哈迈德。我感谢所有埃米尔。

“我热爱赞法拉州。我很高兴来到这里。总统先生让我告诉你们，他会继续为你们而努力。尼日利亚将继续繁荣，安拉如此。”

此前，达乌达·拉瓦勒州长感谢蒂努布参议员通过“ renewed Hope Initiative ”持续支持赞法拉州，包括该倡议下开展的食物援助计划。她说：“阁下、尼日利亚母后，您今天的到来不仅仅是一次官方访问。您在我们亲爱的赞法拉州历史上树立了典范。

“阁下、尊敬的女士们和先生们，在赞法拉州，我们坚信，赋予妇女权能不仅是政府的责任，也是对社会道德、经济繁荣、家庭稳定和持久和平的一项必要且值得投资的举措。

“我向阁下保证，赞法拉州政府和人民将坚定不移地支持总统先生连任。有了在场的妇女以及支持她们的男士，赞法拉州和西北部将在2027年1月为总统先生交出令人满意的成绩。”

https://leadership.ng/oriire-abduction-p.summary: His response followed Makinde’s disclosure during an interview that he did not speak with President Tinubu throughout the over 50 days the victims were held captive, despite attempts to reach the President through his aide. Addressing the governor directly, Ogra said the federal government remained focused on its mandate to secure and prosper Nigeria under President Tinubu.
https://leadership.ng/oriire-abduction-p.summary_zh: 他的回应紧随马金德披露的情况之后。马金德在采访中表示，在受害者被囚禁的50多天里，他始终没有与蒂努布总统说过话，尽管曾试图通过总统助理联系总统。奥格拉直接对州长表示，在蒂努布总统领导下，联邦政府仍专注于确保尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）安全与繁荣这一使命。
https://leadership.ng/oriire-abduction-p.body: Senior Special Assistant to the President on Digital and New Media, Otega Ogra, said the Federal Government immediately deployed military and intelligence assets to Oyo State following the incident. Ogra, in a post on his X handle, said the operations led to the successful rescue of all the abducted children and teachers on July 10, 2026. His response followed Makinde’s disclosure during an interview that he did not speak with President Tinubu throughout the over 50 days the victims were held captive, despite attempts to reach the President through his aide. Addressing the governor directly, Ogra said the federal government remained focused on its mandate to secure and prosper Nigeria under President Tinubu. He maintained that the President prioritised concrete action and results over political point-scoring in addressing security challenges. According to him, the administration has introduced measures to strengthen the country’s security architecture, including the creation of a new Homeland Security position, improved coordination under the Office of the National Security Adviser (ONSA), and better equipment and remuneration for the military. He added that the government had also improved welfare across the security and intelligence agencies. On Makinde’s comments regarding the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC), Ogra stressed that the anti-graft agency remained independent and carried out its statutory responsibilities without political interference. He said President Tinubu had consistently maintained a non-interference policy regarding agencies and regulatory bodies with statutory independence. Ogra, however, criticised the governor’s comments, urging him to concentrate on governance and issue-based campaigning. “In my opinion, sir, political leaders like your good self should prioritise governance or focus on issues-based campaigning rather than such grandstanding that is now becoming the hallmark of your campaign,” he said. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.summary: The recognition underscores Genesis Energy Holdings’commitment to advancing reliable electricity supply, developing critical power infrastructure and supporting the transformation of Lagos State’s energy sector through strategic investments and partnerships. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.summary_zh: 此次认可凸显了Genesis Energy Holdings致力于推进可靠电力供应、建设关键电力基础设施，并通过战略投资与合作推动拉各斯州能源部门转型的承诺。GENESIS还在拉各斯州政府的CLEM倡议框架下与其合作开发“回声项目”，即装机容量为260MW的伊科罗杜电力项目，进一步体现其扩大拉各斯州电力基础设施的决心。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body: The awards presented to Genesis Energy Holding on the opening day of the Summit, at the Landmark Event Centre, Lagos, on Tuesday, 10 November2026, under the theme, “Lagos Energy Evolution: Transforming the Future.” includes the “Most Impactful Project (Power) Award” and the “Excellence in Energy – Summit Partner Appreciation Award.” The first was conferred on the company by Hon Sabur Akanbi Oluwa, Chairman of the Lagos State House of Assembly Committee on Energy and Mineral Resources, while the second award was conferred on the company by Hon. Biodun Ogunleye, Commissioner for Energy and Mineral Resources, Lagos State. The recognition underscores Genesis Energy Holdings’commitment to advancing reliable electricity supply, developing critical power infrastructure and supporting the transformation of Lagos State’s energy sector through strategic investments and partnerships. Through its subsidiary, GELMAK Power Solutions Ltd, the company operates the Banana Island Local Grid Project in Ikoyi, Lagos, an integrated power generation and distribution network providing reliable electricity to residential and commercial customers. Designed to reduce dependence on expensive and polluting diesel and heavy fuel oil (HFO) generators, the project currently records approximately 99% uptime. Its infrastructure capacity was recently doubled from 15MVA to 30MVA following the commissioning of an expanded substation, strengthening its ability to meet the growing electricity demand within the community. Further demonstrating its commitment to expanding electricity infrastructure across Lagos State , GENESIS is developing Project Echo, the 260MW Ikorodu Power Project, in partnership with the Lagos State Government under the CLEM initiative. With the Lagos State Market Operator as off-taker, the gas-fired power project is designed to deliver reliable, grid-integrated electricity, strengthening power supply across Ikorodu and supporting the development of a more resilient electricity market. Once operational, the project is expected to improve electricity availability for households, businesses and industries, while stimulating economic activity and supporting the area’s continued development. Commenting on the awards, Chairman and CEO of Genesis Energy, Mr Akinwole II Omoboriowo, said: “We want to extend our gratitude to Lagos State for giving us the opportunity to serve. We are most grateful for this recognition, which, for us, is both an honour and a call to action – a call to invest more. The business of energy is a very serious affair. Without energy, there can be no life. For us at GENESIS, it is not just a business; it is a lifelong commitment to uplifting our country and our continent, with Lagos State being at the forefront of that commitment.” These investments reflect the Group’s alignment with Lagos State’s electricity sector reform agenda, particularly the objectives of the Lagos State Electricity Law 2024, which provides a framework for developing a competitive, transparent and commercially viable electricity market. Since its establishment in 2005, Genesis Energy Holdings has developed and financed clean energy projects across Africa, with operations and project footprints spanning 11 African countries. The company deploys a diverse range of technologies, including solar photovoltaic (PV), battery energy storage systems (BESS), natural gas, wind, hydro and hybrid solutions, to develop reliable and sustainable energy infrastructure for businesses, governments and communities. Its Nigerian portfolio includes the 84MW gas-fired power project at the Port Harcourt Refinery Complex, one of Nigeria’s largest licensed private off-grid power plants and NIDI project in Kano. In 2025, the Group further expanded its engagement in Nigeria through a US$500 million Memorandum of Understanding with the Katsina State Government for the development, financing, construction, operation and maintenance of major energy infrastructure projects across the State. With a vision to “Light Up Africa One Community at a Time,” GENESIS remains committed to developing and deploying reliable, affordable and sustainable energy infrastructure that addresses the continent’s growing energy needs. Through strategic investments, innovative technologies and partnerships with governments and private-sector stakeholders, the company continues to advance energy access, strengthen energy security and support economic development across Africa
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.title_zh: Genesis Energy 在拉各斯能源峰会上赢得两项奖项，进一步彰显其推动电力基础设施发展的承诺
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body_zh: 2026年11月10日星期二，在拉各斯Landmark Event Centre举行的峰会开幕当天，Genesis Energy Holding以“拉各斯能源演进：塑造未来”为主题获得“最具影响力项目（电力）奖”和“能源卓越奖——峰会合作伙伴致谢奖”。第一项奖由拉各斯州议会议会能源与矿产资源委员会主席Hon Sabur Akanbi Oluwa授予公司，第二项奖由拉各斯州能源与矿产资源专员Hon. Biodun Ogunleye授予公司。这一认可凸显了Genesis Energy Holdings致力于推进可靠电力供应、建设关键电力基础设施，并通过战略投资与合作推动拉各斯州能源部门转型的承诺。公司通过子公司GELMAK Power Solutions Ltd运营位于拉各斯Ikoyi的Banana Island Local Grid项目。该项目是一体化发电与配电网络，为住宅和商业客户提供可靠电力，旨在减少对昂贵且污染严重的柴油和重燃油（HFO）发电机的依赖，目前运行时间占比约为99%。扩建变电站投运后，其基础设施容量近期从15MVA增至30MVA，增强了满足社区不断增长的用电需求的能力。GENESIS还与拉各斯州政府合作，在CLEM倡议框架下开发Echo项目，即260MW的Ikorodu电力项目，以进一步扩大拉各斯州电力基础设施。项目由拉各斯州市场运营商作为购电方，这座燃气发电项目旨在输送可靠、并网运行的电力，加强Ikorodu的电力供应，并支持建设更具韧性的电力市场。项目投入运营后，预计将改善家庭、企业和工业用电的可用性，同时激发经济活动并支持当地持续发展。Genesis Energy董事长兼首席执行官Akinwole II Omoboriowo先生谈及获奖时表示：“我们要向拉各斯州给予我们服务机会表示由衷感谢。我们非常感谢这份认可，对我们而言，它既是一份荣誉，也是一项行动号召——呼吁我们加大投资。能源事业是一项非常严肃的事业。没有能源，就没有生活。对GENESIS而言，能源不仅是一门生意，更是一项毕生致力于提升我们国家和我们大陆福祉的承诺，而拉各斯州始终走在这一承诺的最前沿。”这些投资体现着集团与拉各斯州电力部门改革议程的一致性，特别是对《2024年拉各斯州电力法》目标的支持。该法为建设竞争、透明且具有商业可行性的电力市场提供了框架。自2005年成立以来，Genesis Energy Holdings已在非洲各地开发并资助清洁能源项目，业务及项目遍及11个非洲国家。公司采用多种技术，包括太阳能光伏（PV）、电池储能系统（BESS）、天然气、风能、水电和混合能源解决方案，为企业、政府和社区建设可靠、可持续的能源基础设施。其在尼日利亚的项目组合包括位于哈科特港炼油厂的84MW燃气发电项目——这是尼日利亚规模最大的持牌私营离网电站之一——以及位于卡诺的NIDI项目。2025年，集团通过与卡塔琳娜州政府签署价值US$500 million的谅解备忘录，进一步扩大在尼日利亚的业务合作，开发、融资、建设和运营维护该州的大型能源基础设施项目。秉持“逐个社区点亮非洲”的愿景，GENESIS继续致力于开发和部署可靠、可负担且可持续的能源基础设施，应对非洲大陆不断增长的能源需求。公司通过战略投资、创新技术以及与政府和私营部门相关方的合作，持续推进能源可及性、强化能源安全并支持非洲各地经济发展。

https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.summary_zh: 都柏林——微软产品周五大面积中断，引发了欧洲要求掌控自身数字基础设施的新一轮呼声，尤其是在人工智能前景充满不确定性的情况下。Mensch没有专门评论此次微软服务中断；该中断持续近24小时，影响了74个国家的数百万用户。
https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.body: DUBLIN — Friday's widespread outage of Microsoft products has sparked a new wave of calls for Europe to control its own digital infrastructure — especially with the uncertain future of artificial intelligence at stake. "Only 20% of European digital services run on European infrastructure," Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch said in remarks Friday after he addressed EU national leaders during their first-ever meeting on artificial intelligence in Dublin. The money spent on foreign, U.S. or Chinese, technology "could be reinvested here, on infrastructure we control and [to] finance European research and development," said the boss of Europe's leading AI frontier lab. Mensch didn't specifically address the Microsoft outage, which lasted nearly 24 hours and affected millions of users in 74 countries. Still, the shutdown of key tools like Outlook email and Teams messaging impacted plenty of the tech and government leaders gathered in Dublin to chart Europe’s AI future. French President Emmanuel Macron closed the day with a post on X : “Our independence cannot be outsourced. It must be built here at home, in Europe,” he wrote. "When it comes to artificial intelligence, too, Europe has everything it takes to compete. We have no time to lose.” Tech sovereignty, including control over the cloud, chips and models that power AI, has been a rallying cry of the second mandate of European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, and was one of the key agenda items at Friday's gathering of the leaders of the EU's 27 member countries. "We have outsourced too much of our digital infrastructure to actors outside the EU," Finnish European Parliament lawmaker Aura Salla said in a press release Friday following the outage. She suggested that government contracts specifically "must support European technology." Others zoned in on the risk created by relying on digital infrastructure controlled by a couple of large companies. The Microsoft outage is a "reminder of the systemic risk created by concentrating digital infrastructure with a few global tech giants," said Sebastian Toffaletti, secretary general of the Digital SME Alliance, in a statement shared with POLITICO. In Germany, lawmaker Johannes Schätzl from the Social Democratic Party said it raised questions about public procurement. “Digital sovereignty must be measured by whether we can remain operational even during outages like this,” he said
https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.title_zh: Microsoft 故障再次引发欧洲摆脱美国科技依赖的呼声
https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.body_zh: 都柏林——微软旗下产品周五发生大范围故障，再次引发要求欧洲掌控自身数字基础设施的呼声，尤其是在人工智能前景存在不确定性的背景下。Mistral首席执行官Arthur Mensch周五发表讲话称：“欧洲只有20%的数字服务运行在欧洲的基础设施上。”他此前在都柏林举行的首次欧盟各国领导人人工智能会议上发表了演讲。这家欧洲领先的前沿人工智能实验室负责人说，花在外国、美国或中国技术上的资金“可以在这里重新投资，用于我们掌控的基础设施，并资助欧洲的研究与开发”。Mensch没有直接评论微软故障。这次故障持续近24小时，影响了74个国家的数百万用户。不过，包括Outlook电子邮件和Teams即时通信在内的关键工具中断，还是影响了许多齐聚都柏林、筹划欧洲人工智能未来的科技和政府领导人。法国总统Emmanuel Macron在X上发帖为当天收尾：“我们的独立不能外包。必须在这里、在欧洲亲手建设。”他写道：“谈到人工智能，欧洲同样具备参与竞争的一切条件。我们没有时间可以浪费。”包括掌控云、芯片和人工智能模型在内的技术主权，一直是欧洲委员会主席Ursula von der Leyen第二任期的号召，也是周五欧盟27个成员国领导人会议的主要议程之一。芬兰籍欧洲议会议员Aura Salla在故障发生后于周五发布的新闻稿中说：“我们已将太多数字基础设施外包给欧盟之外的参与者。”她建议，政府合同必须明确“支持欧洲技术”。其他人则将焦点放在依赖少数几家公司掌控的数字基础设施所带来的风险上。Digital SME Alliance秘书长Sebastian Toffaletti在与POLITICO分享的一份声明中说，微软故障“提醒人们，将数字基础设施集中在少数全球科技巨头手中，会造成系统性风险”。德国社会民主党的议员Johannes Schätzl表示，此事引出了有关公共采购的问题。他说：“数字主权必须以我们能否在此类故障期间仍保持运行为衡量标准。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: Nigeria’s High Commissioner to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, has presented his Letter of Credence to South African President Cyril Ramaphosa, marking the official commencement of his diplomatic assignment in the country. Mr Fani-Kayode presented his letter to Mr Ramaphosa at the Sefako Makgatho Presidential Guest House in Pretoria, the official residence of the South African Presidency, on Friday. The High Commissioner shared the development on X, describing the event as “great and historic.” Letters of credence are formal diplomatic documents issued by a country’s head of state to confirm the appointment of a High Commissioner or permanent representative. They officially introduce the envoy to the receiving authority, in this case, the South African president, and certify that the individual is empowered to speak and act on behalf of their nation. Mr Fani-Kayode presented his letter of credence alongside ambassadors from 14 other countries. Each was formally introduced and given the floor to speak. He pledged to strengthen diplomatic relations between both countries, describing the restoration of their historic friendship as a key priority of his diplomatic mission. The envoy, also accredited to Lesotho and Eswatini, conveyed President Bola Tinubu’s goodwill to Mr Ramaphosa. This comes amid tense relations between Nigeria and South Africa over xenophobic violence that forced many African states to evacuate their citizens residing in the country. Mr Fani-Kayode had previously condemned violence against Nigerian nationals by South African security officials. He estimated that at least 30 Nigerians have been killed by the state’s police in the last four years. 12 Nigerians have also been killed since the start of the year. In September, the High Commissioner said Nigeria’s patience was running thin. Speaking at the ceremony, however, Mr Fani-Kayode recalled Nigeria’s support for South Africa during the struggle against apartheid, saying both countries shared a longstanding history of solidarity and friendship. He described Nigeria and South Africa as major trading partners on the continent and stressed the importance of preserving their historical ties. “Part of my job here is to reset that relationship, to come and build that bridge, and to ensure that whatever concerns we have, we can work them out and move forward together,” he said. Mr Fani-Kayode added that closer cooperation between the two countries would strengthen Africa’s position and advance the interests of their citizens. “If Nigeria and South Africa work closely together, the destiny of our great continent will be more secure,” he said. The high commissioner also commended South Africa’s contributions to international diplomacy, particularly its role in BRICS, the Global South and the Group of 20 (G20). He described South Africa’s engagement in global affairs as important to strengthening Africa’s representation on the international stage. Meanwhile, Mr Fani-Kayode, on his X handle, complained that the South African presidential media team failed to live-stream his speech despite capturing those of the other ambassadors present. “Of all the 15 introductions and speeches that were made and delivered this morning, only Nigeria’s was cut out,” he said. “To be clear, I repeat, we were the ONLY ones that were left out.” “Clearly, some elements in South Africa do not want to hear what we have to say or see our faces, but we are here to stay as long as we are welcome and have the confidence of President Ramaphosa, which I am sure we do,” he noted further
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.title_zh: 法尼-卡约德向拉马福萨递交国书，正式履任大使
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body_zh: 尼日利亚驻南非大使费米·法尼-卡约德向南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨递交国书，正式开始其在南非的外交任期。法尼-卡约德先生于星期五在比勒陀利亚的塞法科·马卡托总统迎宾馆——南非总统府官方官邸——向拉马福萨先生递交国书。大使在X平台分享了这一消息，称此次活动“重大而具有历史意义”。国书是由一国国家元首签发的正式外交文件，用于确认任命高级专员或常驻代表。国书向接受国主管机构正式介绍特使，本例中的接受国主管机构是南非总统，并证明该人士获授权代表本国发表言论和采取行动。法尼-卡约德先生与其他14个国家的大使一同递交国书。每位大使均获正式介绍，并获发言机会。他承诺加强两国外交关系，并将恢复两国历史友谊列为其外交使命的一项重点。该特使同时获派驻莱索托和斯威士兰，并向拉马福萨先生转达了博拉·蒂努布总统的友好问候。此前，尼日利亚与南非因针对外国人的暴力袭击而关系紧张，许多非洲国家被迫撤离居住在南非的本国公民。法尼-卡约德先生此前曾谴责南非安全官员针对尼日利亚公民的暴力行为。他估计，过去四年间，该国警察已造成至少30名尼日利亚人死亡。今年年初以来，又有12名尼日利亚人死亡。9月，大使表示尼日利亚的耐心已接近极限。不过，法尼-卡约德先生在仪式上回顾了尼日利亚在南非反抗种族隔离斗争期间对南非的支持，称两国共享源远流长的团结与友谊历史。他将尼日利亚和南非描述为非洲大陆的重要贸易伙伴，并强调维护两国历史联系的重要性。他说：“我在这里承担的工作之一，就是重置双方关系，前来搭建这座桥梁，并确保无论双方有何关切，都能共同解决分歧，携手向前。”法尼-卡约德先生补充说，两国加强合作将增强非洲的立场，并促进两国公民的利益。他说：“如果尼日利亚和南非紧密合作，我们这个伟大大陆的未来将更加稳固。”大使还赞扬南非对国际外交的贡献，尤其是南非在金砖国家、全球南方和二十国集团（G20）中的作用。他表示，南非参与全球事务对于加强非洲在国际舞台上的代表性至关重要。与此同时，法尼-卡约德先生在其X账号上抱怨，尽管南非总统媒体团队拍摄了其他在场大使的演讲，却未对本国演讲进行直播。他说：“今天上午进行的15次介绍和发言中，唯独尼日利亚的发言被剪掉了。”“明确地说，我再重复一遍，我们是唯一被排除在外的。”他进一步指出：“显然，南非某些人士不希望听到我们要说的话，也不希望看到我们的面孔；但只要我们受到欢迎，并得到拉马福萨总统的信任，我们就会留在这里。我确信我们确实得到了他的信任。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The US government is doubling down on its immigration control, with the State Department revoking over 6,000 visas belonging to foreigners engaged in or facilitating birth tourism. The department announced on Thursday, through its X handle, that its Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force had revoked the visas of people identified as involved in the practice. “The Department of State’s Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force has now revoked more than 6,000 visas from foreigners who engaged in or facilitated birth tourism,” the post read. It also said the task force is still identifying and “holding accountable everyone involved in this illicit practice.” This implies that more visas are likely to be revoked over this practice in the future. Birth tourism refers to travelling to another country, usually while pregnant, to give birth so the child can acquire that country’s citizenship or nationality by birth. The latest action signals a wider crackdown on both participants and facilitators, including those who help arrange such travel. Last month, the department announced that it had revoked over 4,000 visas, and that 700 of the revoked visas belonged to Chinese nationals. The latest statement, however, did not provide a breakdown by nationality. As such, it remains unclear whether Nigerians were among those affected. A core aspect of President Donald Trump’s “America first” policy and political campaigns has been a crackdown on immigration. The US leader, during his presidential campaigns, pledged to increase deportations of people living in the country, restrict asylum and refugee admissions, and tighten both illegal and some legal immigration pathways. Since resuming office, Mr Trump has implemented several policies aligned with this agenda. At the inauguration ceremony, for instance, he signed an executive order declaring illegal immigration a national emergency and ordered the speedy deportation of undocumented migrants. The United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement crackdown on migrants has, in the past year, been criticised for human rights violations. The Trump administration also imposed visa bans on several countries, including Nigeria. It is also planning to introduce a policy requiring foreign nationals in the US seeking to change their status from temporary visa holders to permanent residents to return to their home country to apply for a Green Card
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 美国在打击“生育旅游”行动中撤销了6,000多份签证
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 美国政府正在加强移民管控。美国国务院吊销了6,000多张签证，持证人均为参与或协助“生育旅游”的外国人。该部门周四通过其X账号宣布，其“生育旅游防范特遣队”已吊销被认定参与这一行为者的签证。帖文称：“美国国务院生育旅游防范特遣队现已吊销6,000多张签证，涉及参与或协助生育旅游的外国人。”帖文还表示，特遣队仍在查明并“追究所有参与这一非法行为者的责任”。这意味着，未来可能还会因这一行为吊销更多签证。生育旅游是指前往另一个国家，通常在怀孕期间前往当地生产，使孩子通过出生取得该国国籍或身份。最新行动表明，美国正在更广泛地打击参与者和协助者，包括帮助安排此类旅行的人。上个月，该部门宣布已吊销4,000多张签证，其中700张被吊销的签证属于中国公民。不过，最新声明没有提供按国籍划分的明细。因此，目前尚不清楚尼日利亚公民是否在受影响的签证持有人之列。严厉打击移民一直是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普“美国优先”政策和政治竞选的核心内容之一。美国领导人在竞选期间承诺增加对居住在美国的外国人的驱逐力度，限制庇护和难民接收，并收紧非法移民以及部分合法移民通道。特朗普复任以来，已实施多项符合这一议程的政策。例如，在就职典礼上，他签署行政命令，将非法移民宣布为全国紧急状态，并下令迅速遣返无证移民。过去一年，美国移民与海关执法局针对移民的执法行动因侵犯人权而受到批评。特朗普政府还对包括尼日利亚在内的多个国家实施签证禁令。该政府还计划推出新政策，要求在美国希望从临时签证持有人身份转为永久居民的外籍人士返回其原籍国申请绿卡

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显周五在会见中国外交部长王毅时表示，朝鲜半岛和平符合韩国和中国的共同利益，并呼吁加强双边沟通，推动半岛局势发展。赵显在开场发言中说：“朝鲜半岛问题事关韩国的重大利益，半岛的和平与稳定符合两国共同利益。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun said Friday that peace on the Korean Peninsula serves the shared interests of South Korea and China during a meeting with his Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, calling for stronger bilateral communication to advance the situation on the peninsula. The ministerial talks took place in Beijing ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen next week, where President Lee Jae Myung and Chinese President Xi Jinping are expected to meet. "The Korean Peninsula issue is a vital interest for South Korea, and peace and stability on the peninsula serve the shared interests of both countries," Cho said in his opening remarks. "I hope the two countries will continue to strengthen strategic communication to make progress on the situation on the Korean Peninsula," he added, expressing hope that a meeting between the two leaders in Shenzhen would provide an opportunity to further develop their strategic cooperative partnership. Wang said bilateral relations had returned to a normal track following the leaders' reciprocal visits last year and early this year, stressing the need to maintain high-level exchanges and further develop their strategic partnership. Noting that bilateral trade is expected to reach a record high this year, he expressed hope that people-to-people exchanges would recover to around 10 million annually. With the two countries hosting the APEC summit consecutively, Wang called for joint efforts to promote regional development and prosperity, expressing hope that the upcoming summit would give fresh momentum to bilateral ties. South Korea hosted last year's APEC summit in the southeastern city of Gyeongju. At that time, the two ministers exchanged views on bilateral relations and Korean Peninsula issues, with Cho calling for Beijing to play a constructive role in bringing North Korea back to dialogue. Before departing for Beijing for a two-day visit earlier in the day, Cho said he and Xi planned to discuss issues that need to be coordinated ahead of the APEC summit, as well as North Korea-related matters, including the possibility of U.S.-North Korea talks. Other issues on the agenda include pending bilateral matters, such as ways to enhance economic and cultural exchanges and cooperation, as well as Chinese structures installed in the Yellow Sea. The talks come amid deepening ties between China and North Korea, following Xi's visit to Pyongyang in June and a series of high-level exchanges between the two countries. Wang accompanied Xi during his visit to the United States in August. He was also present during Kim's surprise visit to the Chinese border city of Dandong last month. Inter-Korean relations, however, remain frozen. Pyongyang defines ties with Seoul as those between two hostile states and has rejected the Lee Jae Myung administration's calls for dialogue. There has been speculation about a possible meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during Trump's trip to Asia for the APEC summit, as the U.S. president has expressed interest in resuming dialogue with Pyongyang. Asked whether he believes China is willing to mediate between Washington and Pyongyang, Cho expressed uncertainty over how actively Beijing might pursue such efforts. "I don't think there is much chance of China actively inviting (Kim) to the APEC summit for talks, but it is still too early to tell," the minister said. A South Korean presidential official said Thursday that a meeting between Trump and Kim on the sidelines of the APEC summit was unlikely, while noting that it was difficult to predict whether contact between the two leaders might take place before or after the summit
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 赵兑烈在会见王毅期间表示，朝半岛和平符合韩国与中国的共同利益
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显周五在会见中国 counterparts 王毅时表示，朝鲜半岛的和平符合韩国和中国的共同利益，并呼吁加强双边沟通，推动半岛局势发展。这场部长级会谈在北京举行，先于下周在深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会；韩国总统李在明和中国国家主席习近平预计将在峰会上会晤。赵显在开场发言中说：“朝鲜半岛问题是韩国的核心利益，半岛的和平稳定符合两国共同利益。我希望两国继续加强战略沟通，推动朝鲜半岛局势取得进展。”他还表示，希望两国领导人在深圳会晤能为进一步发展战略合作伙伴关系提供机会。王毅表示，在两国领导人去年及今年年初相互访问后，双边关系已回到正常轨道，并强调需要保持高层交往，进一步发展战略伙伴关系。他指出，预计今年双边贸易额将创历史新高，并希望民间交往恢复到每年约1000人次的水平。鉴于两国将连续主办APEC峰会，王毅呼吁共同努力，促进区域发展与繁荣，并希望即将举行的峰会为双边关系注入新的动力。韩国去年在东南部城市庆州主办了APEC峰会。当时，两国外长就双边关系和朝鲜半岛问题交换了意见，赵显呼吁北京在促使朝鲜重返对话方面发挥建设性作用。当天早些时候，在启程前往北京进行为期两天的访问之前，赵显表示，他与习近平计划讨论APEC峰会前需要协调的议题以及与朝鲜有关的事务，包括举行美朝会谈的可能性。议程中的其他议题还包括尚未解决的双边事务，例如加强经济文化交流与合作的办法，以及黄海上的中国设施。会谈是在中国与朝鲜关系日益密切的背景下举行的。此前，习近平于6月访问平壤，两国之间进行了一系列高层交往。8月习近平访问美国时，王毅陪同出访。上个月，朝鲜最高领导人金正恩突然访问中国边境城市丹东时，王毅也在场。然而，朝韩关系仍陷于僵局。平壤将首尔关系定义为两个敌对国家之间的关系，并拒绝李在明政府提出的对话倡议。随着美国总统唐纳德·特朗普赴亚洲出席APEC峰会，外界一直在猜测特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩可能会晤，因为这位美国总统已表示有兴趣恢复与平壤的对话。当被问及是否认为中国愿意在华盛顿与平壤之间进行调解时，赵显对北京会多积极地推进相关努力表示不确定。这位部长说：“我认为中国主动邀请（金正恩）参加APEC峰会会谈的可能性不大，但现在下结论还为时过早。”一名韩国总统府官员周四表示，特朗普与金正恩在APEC峰会期间会面的可能性不大，同时指出，难以预测两位领导人是否会在峰会前或峰会后进行接触

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary_zh: 韩国产业部表示，在国际油价高企和中东地区持续紧张局势的背景下，韩国政府周五连续第五个周期维持燃油产品最高限价不变。自6月26日下调后，政府已将最高限价维持在当前水平20周。政府于3月中旬推出燃油最高限价，旨在稳定因美伊战争在中东引发的供应链中断而出现波动的国内燃油价格。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: The Korean government on Friday kept its price caps on fuel products unchanged for a fifth consecutive period amid elevated international oil prices and continued tensions in the Middle East, the industry ministry said. The maximum prices at which local refiners can supply gasoline, diesel and kerosene to gas stations will remain unchanged at 1,784 won ($1.3), 1,773 won and 1,380 won per liter, respectively, for the four weeks beginning Saturday, according to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources. The government has kept the caps at their current levels for 20 weeks since June 27, following a reduction on June 26. "International oil prices fell below $100 per barrel, with Brent crude reaching $96 per barrel on Nov. 12. However, the price remains more than $20 higher than at the end of June," the ministry said. The freeze is aimed at easing upward pressure on consumer prices amid elevated oil prices and high ocean freight costs, it added. The government introduced the fuel price caps in mid-March to stabilize domestic fuel prices amid supply chain disruptions stemming from the U.S.-Iran war in the Middle East. It plans to adjust the emergency measures as necessary while closely monitoring developments in the Middle East and economic conditions at home
