https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿——韩国常驻美国最高特使周三再次表示，首尔愿意就拟议中的阿拉斯加液化天然气（LNG）项目开展合作，同时强调参与该项目所需满足的商业和法律条件。首尔与华盛顿在该拟议项目所处阶段的问题上存在分歧。白宫此前曾表示，有540亿美元与阿拉斯加项目挂钩，但首尔一直坚持，其参与该项目的决定仍须以商业可行性评估结果为前提。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — South Korea's top envoy to the United States on Wednesday reaffirmed Seoul's willingness to cooperate on a proposed Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) project while emphasizing commercial and legal conditions for participation. Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha made the remarks in an opinion piece published in the Washington Post, outlining progress in South Korea's US$350 billion investment commitment to the U.S. "Korea and the U.S. have also agreed to commence working on the Alaska LNG project, subject to meeting commercial reasonableness and applicable domestic legal requirements," Kang wrote. Her remarks came amid differences between Seoul and Washington over the status of the proposed project. The White House previously said $54 billion was tied to the Alaska project, but Seoul has maintained that its participation remains subject to a commercial viability review. Kang did not specify an investment figure for the Alaska project, even as she outlined financial commitments for other major energy initiatives in the United States. She said the two governments had agreed on a framework for up to $120 billion in Korean investment to build eight large-scale nuclear reactors in the United States. "This would involve up to $120 billion in Korean investment in eight large-scale reactors to be built by Korean and American companies," she wrote. Kang also stressed the importance of mutual trust and honoring commitments as the alliance expands into advanced technologies and other strategic sectors. "As our cooperation expands into advanced technologies and other strategic sectors, long-term success will depend not simply on short-term opportunities but on reliable partners and mutual confidence that commitments will be honored," she wrote. Last month, U.S. President Donald Trump threatened to "charge" South Korea "more" if it does not agree to invest in the Alaska project. "If they don't want to do it, that's okay with me. I'll just charge them more," Trump said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 韩国特使重申首尔对拟议中的阿拉斯加液化天然气项目采取有条件支持的立场
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——韩国常驻美国大使姜京华周三表示，韩国愿意就拟议中的阿拉斯加液化天然气（LNG）项目开展合作，同时强调参与该项目的商业和法律条件。姜京华在《华盛顿邮报》刊登的评论文章中说明了韩国承诺向美国投资3500亿美元的进展，并概述了双方在相关问题上的立场。姜京华写道：“韩国和美国也已同意启动阿拉斯加LNG项目，但前提是符合商业合理性并满足适用的国内法律要求。”她的表态正值首尔与华盛顿就该拟议项目的现状存在分歧之际。白宫此前表示，有540亿美元与阿拉斯加项目挂钩，但首尔一直坚持，其参与仍须接受商业可行性审查。姜京华没有说明阿拉斯加项目的投资金额，同时概述了韩国对美国其他重大能源项目的资金承诺。她说，两国政府已就韩国在美国投资最多1200亿美元建设8座大型核反应堆达成框架协议。她写道：“这将涉及韩国投资最多1200亿美元，用于建设由韩国和美国企业承建的8座大型反应堆。”姜京华还强调，随着同盟关系拓展至先进技术及其他战略领域， mutual信任和信守承诺十分重要。她写道：“随着我们的合作拓展至先进技术及其他战略领域，长期成功不仅取决于短期机会，也取决于可靠的伙伴，以及彼此相信各方会信守承诺。”上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普威胁称，如果韩国不同意投资阿拉斯加项目，他就会让韩国“付出更多”。特朗普说：“如果他们不想这么做，我也没问题。我只会让他们付出更多。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿——美国海军一名高级指挥官强调，与韩国开展教育和培训合作的重要性，称两国水兵之间的联系是对双边联盟的持久投资。据周一发布的一份美国军方报告，美国海军教育与训练司令部司令Greg Huffman于10月27日在佛罗里达州彭萨科拉海军航空站韩国海军训练舰ROKS Hansando上举行的招待会上表示了上述观点。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — A senior U.S. Navy commander has highlighted the importance of education and training cooperation with South Korea, describing ties between sailors of the two countries as a lasting investment in the bilateral alliance. "The friendships formed during this voyage are among the most lasting and mutually beneficial investments our alliance can make," Rear Adm. Greg Huffman, commander of the U.S. Naval Education and Training Command, said during an Oct. 27 reception aboard South Korea's naval training ship ROKS Hansando at Naval Air Station Pensacola in Florida, according to a U.S. military report released Monday. During the visit, Huffman also met with senior South Korean naval officers, including Vice Adm. Park Kyu-paek, superintendent of the Korea Naval Academy, and Rear Adm. Kim Joon-yup, commander of the South Korean Navy's Cruise Training Task Group. "Our mission is fundamentally about people - recruiting, training, educating and developing sailors to serve with competence, character and confidence," Huffman said. "This development is not confined to a classroom; it is a career-long journey that is immeasurably strengthened when we learn alongside trusted allies." The visit followed a series of exchanges between the two countries' naval education and training commands, including a September 2025 visit to Pensacola by South Korean Vice Adm. Kang Jeong-ho and Huffman's visit to Jinhae, South Korea, in September this year. During his visit to Jinhae, Huffman held discussions with South Korean naval officials on professional military education, personnel development and opportunities for continued cooperation, according to the report. South Korean sailors aboard the Hansando also visited Veterans Memorial Park in Pensacola on, where they laid a wreath at the Korean War Memorial to honor those who served in the 1950-53 conflict
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国海军司令在访问韩国期间强调与韩国的训练合作
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国海军一名高级指挥官强调了与韩国开展教育和培训合作的重要性，称两国水兵之间的联系是双方联盟的一项持久投资。美国海军教育与训练司令部司令、海军少将格雷格·赫夫曼周一发布的一份美国军方报告显示，10月27日，他在佛罗里达州彭萨科拉海军航空站举行的招待会上表示：“此次航行中建立的友谊，是我们的联盟所能作出的最持久、最有利于双方的投资之一。”招待会在韩国海军训练舰“汉山岛”号上举行。访问期间，赫夫曼还会见了韩国海军多名高级军官，包括韩国海军学院院长朴圭白海军中将和韩国海军巡航训练特遣队司令金俊燮海军少将。赫夫曼说：“我们的使命本质上关乎人才——招募水兵、开展培训和教育，培养他们以胜任、品格和自信履行使命。这种培养并不局限于课堂，而是一段贯穿职业生涯的历程；当我们与值得信赖的盟友一起学习时，这种培养会得到无法估量的加强。”此次访问是在两国海军教育与训练司令部进行一系列交流之后开展的，其中包括韩国海军中将姜正浩于2025年9月访问彭萨科拉，以及赫夫曼今年9月访问韩国金海。根据报告，赫夫曼在金海访问期间与韩国海军官员讨论了职业军事教育、人才培养以及继续合作的机会。韩国水兵还在彭萨科拉参观了退伍军人纪念公园，并在朝鲜战争纪念碑前敬献花圈，以纪念参加1950年至1953年冲突的人员

https://leadership.ng/i-will-protect-all.title: I Will Protect All Faiths In Nigeria, Olawepo-Hashim Tells US Congress
https://leadership.ng/i-will-protect-all.summary: Accord Party presidential candidate, Dr. Gbenga Olawepo-Hashim, has told the United States Congress and the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF) that protecting every Nigerian’s right to worship freely must become a central pillar of the country’s security and conflict prevention strategy.
https://leadership.ng/i-will-protect-all.summary_zh: Accord党总统候选人 Gbenga Olawepo-Hashim 博士告诉美国国会和美国国际宗教自由委员会（USCIRF），保护每一位尼日利亚人自由礼拜的权利，必须成为该国安全与冲突预防战略的核心支柱。
https://leadership.ng/i-will-protect-all.body: Accord Party presidential candidate, Dr. Gbenga Olawepo-Hashim, has told the United States Congress and the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF) that protecting every Nigerian’s right to worship freely must become a central pillar of the country’s security and conflict prevention strategy. In a policy brief submitted ahead of a US House Hearing on Nigeria, yesterday, Olawepo-Hashim acknowledged the persecution of Christians in parts of the country, including attacks on churches, killings of pastors and destruction of communities. He, however, cautioned against presenting Nigeria’s religious crisis solely as a conflict between Christians and Muslims, a statement from his media office disclosed on Wednesday. “Christians in northern and central Nigeria face persecution. Churches have been burned, villages destroyed, and pastors killed. This is real,” he said. He continued, “But Shia Muslims, minority sects, and Hausa Muslim communities also face persecution and discrimination. Framing Nigeria as Christians versus Muslims divides Nigeria. Framing it as all victims versus violent extremism unites Nigeria.” He argued that religious freedom should be treated not only as a human rights issue but also as an instrument of conflict prevention and national security. “When people cannot worship freely, they feel excluded. When killers are not punished, impunity grows. When impunity grows, communities form militias. When militias grow, extremists recruit from them,” he said. Olawepo-Hashim said that, if elected, his administration would develop and implement a National Policy Framework on Religious Freedom for Conflict Prevention and Countering Violent Extremism. Within its first 90 days, he proposed convening a National Summit involving victims, the Christian Association of Nigeria (CAN), the Nigeria Supreme Council for Islamic Affairs (NSCIA), Shia leaders, Hausa cultural representatives, women, young people and internally displaced persons. He also pledged to pursue a National Religious Freedom for Conflict Prevention and Countering Violent Extremism Act within 180 days of assuming office. The proposed legislation, he said, would criminalise religious persecution, hate incitement and forced displacement. Another proposal is an Independent National Commission, with offices in all 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory, reporting to the National Assembly. Under the proposed arrangement, attacks would be investigated within 30 days, findings made public and victims compensated. Olawepo-Hashim also proposed establishing a National Guard to protect vulnerable villages, farms, schools and places of worship. He added that the broader security programme would support the return of displaced people and the rebuilding of destroyed communities, including those in Shanga, Plateau, Benue, Kaduna and Borno. “This is a Nigerian solution for Nigeria and a model for West Africa and Africa,” he said. The Accord candidate called on the United States to partner with Nigeria in convening an International Conference on Security in Nigeria and the Sahel within the first 100 days of his presidency, if elected. The proposed conference would bring together ECOWAS, the African Union, the United States and other international partners to develop a coordinated strategy covering religious freedom, conflict prevention, intelligence sharing, border security and countering violent extremism. “Nigeria should lead, with the United States as partner. If Nigeria gets this right, West Africa and Africa will follow,” he said. Olawepo-Hashim linked religious freedom and national security to the credibility of the 2027 general elections, warning that political intimidation, incitement and electoral malpractice could deepen existing divisions. “Free, fair, transparent and credible elections mean no religious violence, no intimidation, no incitement and no rigging,” he said. Citing the recent attack on activist and political figure Omoyele Sowore in Ekiti, he warned against allowing political violence to compound the country’s insecurity. “Election rigging is itself a threat to religious freedom, conflict prevention and human rights. A rigged election does not just steal votes; it steals peace.” He urged the United States to support Nigeria’s electoral process through sustained engagement, international observation, technical assistance to the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) and support for civil society. “This is not a request for America to choose Nigeria’s leader. It is a request for America to help Nigerians choose their own leader, free from religious and political violence, intimidation and rigging,” he said. Olawepo-Hashim maintained that Nigeria must lead efforts to demonstrate that religious freedom is not a foreign concept but an African value. “Religious freedom cannot be protected while Boko Haram, ISWAP, Ansaru and bandit terror networks operate with impunity. https://leadership.ng/i-will-protect-all.title_zh: Olawepo-Hashim告诉美国国会：我将保护尼日利亚的所有信仰
https://leadership.ng/i-will-protect-all.body_zh: 协和党总统候选人、博士Gbenga Olawepo-Hashim告诉美国国会和美国国际宗教自由委员会（USCIRF），保护每一名尼日利亚公民自由礼拜的权利，必须成为该国安全与防止冲突战略的核心支柱。Olawepo-Hashim在美国众议院昨日举行的尼日利亚问题听证会前提交的一份政策简报中承认，该国部分地区基督徒遭受迫害，包括针对教堂的袭击、牧师遇害以及社区被毁。然而，他的媒体办公室周三发布的一份声明称，他警告不要将尼日利亚的宗教危机仅仅描述为基督徒与穆斯林之间的冲突。他说：“尼日利亚北部和中部的基督徒遭受迫害。教堂被烧毁，村庄被毁，牧师被杀。这是事实。”他继续说：“但什叶派穆斯林、少数教派和豪萨穆斯林社区也遭受迫害和歧视。将尼日利亚描绘成基督徒对穆斯林会撕裂尼日利亚。将它描绘成所有受害者对暴力极端主义，则能团结尼日利亚。”他认为，宗教自由不仅应被视为人权问题，也应被视为防止冲突和维护国家安全的工具。他说：“当人们无法自由礼拜时，他们会感到自己遭到排斥。当杀人者不受惩罚时，逍遥法外便会加剧。当逍遥法外加剧时，社区就会组织民兵。当民兵壮大时，极端分子就会从中招募人员。”Olawepo-Hashim表示，如果当选，他的政府将制定并实施《防止冲突与打击暴力极端主义宗教自由国家政策框架》。他提议在就职后的前90天内召开一次全国峰会，邀请受害者、尼日利亚基督徒协会（CAN）、尼日利亚伊斯兰事务最高委员会（NSCIA）、什叶派领袖、豪萨文化代表、妇女、青年和境内流离失所者参加。他还承诺在就任180天内推动制定《防止冲突与打击暴力极端主义宗教自由国家法》。他说，拟议立法将把宗教迫害、煽动仇恨和强迫流离失所定为犯罪。另一项提议是成立一个独立的国家委员会，在全部36个州及联邦首都区设立办公室，并向全国议会报告。根据拟议安排，袭击事件将在30天内得到调查，调查结果将予以公布，受害者将获得赔偿。Olawepo-Hashim还提议成立国家卫队，以保护易受攻击的村庄、农场、学校和礼拜场所。他补充说，更广泛的安全计划将支持流离失所者返回家园以及重建被毁社区，包括Shanga、Plateau、Benue、Kaduna和Borno的社区。他说：“这是为尼日利亚制定的尼日利亚方案，也是西非和非洲的典范。”这位协和党候选人呼吁美国在竞选中胜出后的前100天内，与尼日利亚合作召开尼日利亚和萨赫勒安全国际会议。拟议会议将汇集西非国家经济共同体、非洲联盟、美国及其他国际伙伴，制定协调战略，涵盖宗教自由、防止冲突、情报共享、边境安全和打击暴力极端主义。他说：“应由尼日利亚牵头，美国担任伙伴。如果尼日利亚把这件事做好，西非和非洲就会跟上。”Olawepo-Hashim把宗教自由与国家安全同2027年大选的可信度联系起来，警告政治恐吓、煽动和选举舞弊可能加深现有分裂。他说：“自由、公平、透明且可信的选举意味着没有宗教暴力、没有恐吓、没有煽动、没有舞弊。”他提到Ekiti最近针对活动人士和政治人物Omoyele Sowore的袭击，警告不要让政治暴力加剧该国的安全困境。他说：“选举舞弊本身就是对宗教自由、防止冲突和人权的威胁。舞弊选举夺走的不只是选票，还是和平。”他敦促美国通过持续接触、国际观察、向独立国家选举委员会（INEC）提供技术援助以及支持民间社会等方式，支持尼日利亚的选举进程。他说：“这不是要求美国替尼日利亚选择领导人，而是要求美国帮助尼日利亚人自由、不受宗教和政治暴力、恐吓及舞弊威胁，选择自己的领导人。”Olawepo-Hashim坚持认为，尼日利亚必须带头证明宗教自由并非外来概念，而是非洲价值观。他说：“在博科哈拉姆、伊斯兰国西非省、Ansaru和匪徒恐怖网络逍遥法外的情况下，宗教自由无法得到保护。打击暴力极端主义就是保护宗教自由。”他最后总结道。抢先获取最新动态。实时报道、突发独家消息和独到视角将直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，获取全天候更新 →

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 总统Bola Tinubu于星期三敦促奥多州选民，确保他在2027年1月16日总统选举中以至少120万张选票获胜。总统Tinubu由副总统Kashim Shettima代表出席并发表讲话。他说，在该州登记的210万选民中，预计奥多州将投给他不少于120万票。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: President Bola Tinubu , on Wednesday, urged voters in Ondo State to ensure his return with at least 1.2 million votes in the 16 January 2027 presidential election. The president spoke at the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rally in Akure on Wednesday. Represented by Vice President Kashim Shettima, President Tinubu said he expected no less than 1.2 million votes from Ondo out of the 2.1 million registered voters in the state. INEC declared that about 1.8 million voters have collected their Permanent Voter Cards in the state, leaving about 200,000 cards uncollected a few months before the election. “It is our expectation that Ondo should be able to deliver 1.2 million votes out of the 1.8 million PVCs collected so far,” he said. He also mocked his political opponents, such as Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) and the National Democratic Party (NDC), respectively, as lacking the competence and consensus to lead the country. “Looking at the rally today in Ondo, it is shut down. Our political opponents are conducting rallies on Instagram and Facebook,” he said. He also noted that Atiku, who hails from Adamawa State, has no alignment with most notable leaders in his state and therefore lacks the capacity to lead the country. The president said the same about Mr Obi, whom he described as lacking the support of former and present governors of Anambra State. “That you have the ability to import cheap wine from South Africa, does not mean you can govern Nigeria,” The president said of Mr Obi, adding that the country had fared better under the current administration and deserving the votes of all Nigerians. The Ondo State Governor, Lucky Aiyedatiwa, while delivering his welcome address, promised that the state would ensure it delivered nothing less than one million votes for President Tinubu during the election. He said the president’s reforms had trickled down to the masses of Ondo in the form of developments, including key appointments such as three ministers and heads of agencies. But the Director General of the Tinubu Presidential Campaign Council, Abdullaziz Yari, said that, given the benefits accruing to Ondo State from the Tinubu administration, the president deserved more than one million votes from the state. Mr Yari urged party leaders and other members to unite to ensure they deliver the maximum votes in January. Earlier, the Chairman of the Progressives Governors Forum and Governor of Imo State, Hope Uzodima, while addressing the rally, urged Ondo voters to collect their PVCs if they want to deliver the pledged one million votes. He also urged the various groups within the party to close ranks and end the bickering in order to be able to garner the required votes for the president. Senate Leader, Opeyemi Bamidele, also harped on unity among leaders of the party in Ondo State following reports that there are various factions running parallel campaigns for the president. Mr Bamidele, an indigene of the neighbouring Ekiti State, said he had a message from President Tinubu to Ondo APC, urging party leaders to recognise the governor as the coordinator of the campaigns in the state and to team up with him to deliver votes during the election. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 博拉·蒂努布总统周三敦促奥恩多州选民，在2027年1月16日总统选举中确保他至少获得120万张选票。总统于周三在阿库雷举行的全体进步大会党总统竞选集会上发表讲话。副总统卡希姆·谢蒂马代表蒂努布总统出席。蒂努布总统表示，在该州210万名登记选民中，他预计奥恩多州将至少投出120万票。独立国家选举委员会宣布，该州约有180万名选民已经领取永久选民卡，距离选举还有数月，仍有约20万张选民卡尚未领取。他说：“我们期望奥恩多州能够从目前已领取的180万张永久选民卡中投出120万票。”他还嘲讽了非洲民主大会党的阿提库·阿布巴卡尔和人民民主党的彼得·奥比，称他们缺乏领导国家的能力和共识。他说：“看看今天奥恩多州的集会，它已经关闭了。我们的政治对手却是在Instagram和Facebook上举办集会。”他还指出，来自阿达瓦瓦州的阿提库没有得到该州大多数知名领导人的支持，因此缺乏领导国家的能力。总统对奥比先生也表达了同样的看法，称他缺乏阿南布拉州前任和现任州长的支持。总统谈到奥比先生时表示：“你能从南非进口廉价葡萄酒，并不意味着你能够治理尼日利亚。”他补充说，国家在现任政府治理下取得了更好的成效，理应获得所有尼日利亚人的选票。奥恩多州州长拉基·艾耶达蒂瓦在欢迎词中承诺，该州将在选举中确保为蒂努布总统投出不少于100万票。他说，总统推行的改革已经惠及奥恩多州民众，体现在多项发展成就中，包括任命三名部长和各机构负责人。不过，蒂努布总统竞选委员会主任阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里表示，鉴于蒂努布政府为奥恩多州带来的益处，总统理应获得该州超过100万张选票。亚里先生敦促党内领导人和其他成员团结起来，确保在1月为总统争取到尽可能多的选票。此前，进步州长论坛主席、伊莫州州长霍普·乌佐迪马在集会上发言，敦促奥恩多州选民领取永久选民卡，如果他们希望兑现承诺的100万票。他还敦促党内各个团体加强团结、停止争执，以便为总统争取到所需选票。参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱也强调，在有关奥恩多州存在多个派别为总统分别开展竞选活动的报道之后，党内领导人必须团结一致。巴米德莱先生是邻近的埃基蒂州本地人。他说，他带来了蒂努布总统给奥恩多州全体进步大会党成员的信息，敦促党内领导人承认州长是该州竞选活动的协调人，并与州长携手合作，在选举中争取选票。奥恩多州和埃多州前州长奥卢塞贡·米米科与阿德姆斯·奥希奥莫雷，以及拉各斯州州长巴巴吉德·桑沃-奥卢出席了集会。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body: Layer 1 Nigeria produced an average of 1.687 million barrels of crude oil and condensate per day in October 2026, the Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission (NUPRC) has said. Data released by the commission on Wednesday showed that daily production peaked at 1.79 million barrels per day (bpd), while the lowest output during the month was 1.60 million bpd. The data showed that crude oil production, excluding condensate, averaged 1.51 million barrels per day (mbpd) during the review period. This represented 101 per cent of Nigeria’s 1.5 million bpd production quota allocated by the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC). According to the report, Nigeria had met its assigned OPEC crude oil production quota for six consecutive months. It said the country produced 1.53 million bpd in May, 1.55 million bpd in June, 1.51 million bpd in July, 1.50 million bpd in August, 1.53 million bpd in September and 1.51 million bpd in October. The report, however, indicated a 1.7 per cent month-on-month decline in crude oil production. It attributed the relatively stable performance in recent months to improved operational stability, production uptime and crude evacuation efficiency. The commission said the sustained performance in October reflected the commitment of operators and industry stakeholders to improving operational efficiency, maintaining asset integrity and enhancing production reliability across the upstream sector. A breakdown of daily average crude oil and condensate production by terminals and streams showed that Forcados Terminal recorded the highest output of 318.49 thousand barrels per day (kbpd). Bonny Terminal followed with 311.02 kbpd, while Qua Iboe Terminal recorded 173.97 kbpd. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.title_zh: 尼日利亚原油产量达到168万桶/日
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body_zh: 尼日利亚上游石油监管委员会（NUPRC）表示，尼日利亚第一层油田在2026年10月平均每日生产原油和凝析油168.7万桶。该委员会周三发布的数据显示，日产量最高达到179万桶（bpd），当月最低产量为160万桶。数据显示，在审查期内，不含凝析油的原油日均产量为151万桶（mbpd），相当于石油输出国组织（OPEC）分配给尼日利亚的150万桶日产量配额的101%。报告称，尼日利亚已连续6个月完成其获分配的OPEC原油产量配额。该国5月产量为153万桶/日，6月为155万桶/日，7月为151万桶/日，8月为150万桶/日，9月为153万桶/日，10月为151万桶/日。然而，报告指出，原油产量环比下降1.7%。报告将近几个月相对稳定的表现归因于运营稳定性、生产设备可用率及原油外输效率的改善。该委员会表示，10月持续稳定的表现反映了运营商和行业利益相关方为提高运营效率、维护资产完整性以及增强上游行业生产可靠性所作的承诺。按终端和油流划分的原油及凝析油日均产量明细显示，Forcados Terminal产量最高，达到31.849万桶/日（kbpd）。Bonny Terminal以31.102万桶/日紧随其后，Qua Iboe Terminal产量为17.397万桶/日。此处发表的意见不代表Vanguard报社或其任何员工的观点

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: Fresh uncertainties surrounding artificial intelligence (AI) investments following the US midterms could provide a "golden opportunity" for Korea, a high-level science ministry official said Wednesday. Second Vice Science Minister Ryu Je-myung made the remarks at a congratulatory address during an AI conference hosted by the ministry in Seoul as he mentioned growing concerns in the United States that the incoming Democratic Congress could tighten regulations on AI and data centers. "There are observations that market uncertainty could increase amid potential changes in the investment environment for AI and data centers (following the US midterms)," Ryu said at the event. "It (actually) provides a golden opportunity to narrow our gap with leading countries and secure overwhelming national AI competitiveness through aggressive and speedy investments and technological innovation," he added. To that end, the government is considering doubling the amount of funding for the AI sector to around 9.4 trillion won next year, he said. "South Korea is a major research and development powerhouse, whose funding for the R&D sector accounts for over 5 percent of the country's gross domestic product," Ryu pointed out. Meanwhile, markets have been rattled with worries that the Democrats' sweeping victory in the US midterm elections could lead to a slowdown in the building of AI data centers. Such fears have sent the tech-heavy Nasdaq down by more than 5 percent. Local semiconductor giants suffered as well, with Samsung Electronics and SK hynix both shedding over 3 percent, following the election results

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il on Wednesday called for South Korea's financial attaches in overseas missions to closely monitor the impact of the U.S. midterm elections on the global economy, including how individual countries are responding. Lee made the remarks during his first meeting with financial attaches at 18 overseas missions since taking office in September, held virtually to review the latest economic trends in major countries, according to the Ministry of Finance and Economy. During the meeting, Lee stressed that South Korea faces external uncertainties, including fiscal instability in Europe and global geopolitical tensions, despite the country's robust exports. "In order to turn recent achievements into sustainable growth, we need to preemptively identify changes in the external environment and take steps to address risks in advance," Lee said during the meeting. "We also need to focus on how changes in the political landscape following the U.S. midterm elections will affect the Trump administration's policy direction," the finance minister added, asking the attaches to closely monitor relevant developments. The finance minister also called for the attaches to closely watch the fiscal crisis in France and its potential impact on the global economy, as well as global supply chains amid the Russia-Ukraine war and the U.S.-Iran war. The finance ministry said it will continue to communicate closely with the financial attaches to review economic and policy trends in major countries and proactively respond to external risks

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: HD Construction Equipment has joined hands with the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs to honor Ethiopian soldiers who fought and died during the 1950-53 Korean War, unveiling a memorial wall bearing their names at Holy Trinity Cathedral in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The company said it held a ceremony to dedicate the memorial wall at the cathedral on Wednesday, coinciding with the International Memorial Day for U.N. Korean War Veterans. The event was attended by HD Construction Equipment CEO Moon Jae-young, Veterans Minister Kwon Oh-eul, Korean Ambassador to Ethiopia Koo Hong-seok, Ethiopian defense officials and Korean War veterans and their families. HD Construction Equipment and the veterans ministry signed a memorandum of understanding in May to establish memorial facilities in countries that sent troops to support Korea under U.N. Command. Ethiopia was selected as the first site, with HD Construction Equipment covering the full cost of construction. The wall features individual plaques inscribed with the names of the 122 fallen soldiers, as well as messages of gratitude and remembrance in Korean, English and Amharic, Ethiopia's official working language. It also includes a bronze relief depicting members of the Kagnew Battalion marching alongside Ethiopia’s national symbol, the lion. "It is deeply meaningful to permanently inscribe the names of Ethiopian heroes who gave their lives defending Korea's freedom and peace,” Kwon said in his congratulatory remarks for the event. “The government will continue to honor the U.N. veterans who demonstrated extraordinary solidarity and humanity across national borders and do its utmost to ensure that future generations in Korea and the countries that sent troops remember and carry forward the legacy of their service and solidarity." Alongside the memorial project, HD Construction Equipment will expand its cooperation with Ethiopia by supporting efforts to train local workers and develop skills needed for the country's infrastructure and industrial sectors. The company is working with local institutions to establish a training center to develop skilled construction equipment operators and maintenance technicians. The center will provide training in equipment operation and maintenance to local young people, including descendants of Korean War veterans, helping develop skilled workers and expand employment opportunities. “I hope the memorial wall will serve as a place to remember the noble sacrifices of Ethiopian veterans who fought for Korea and pass on their spirit to future generations,” Moon said. Ethiopia was the only African country to deploy ground troops to the Korean War. Its elite Kagnew Battalion, made up of imperial guards, sent about 3,500 soldiers to the conflict and recorded 253 victories in 253 engagements. A total of 122 Ethiopian soldiers were killed
